 18class BrachyApplicator:
 19    r"""
 20    Purpose:
 21        - This class holds the information regarding the brachytherapy applicator.
 22        as well as all the functions to support the necessary applicator operations.
 23
 24    Attributes:
 25        - path:str := path to the applicator geometry file.
 26        - name:str := name of the applicator, which is taken as the basename of the path.
 27        - applicator_mesh := the vtk mesh of the applicator.
 28        - verticies:np.array := the verticies of the applicator mesh.
 29        - faces:np.array := the faces of the applicator mesh.
 30        - origin:np.array := the origin of the applicator.
 31        - rotation:np.array := the rotation of the applicator.
 32        - material:str := the material of the applicator.
 33        - density:float := the density of the applicator.
 34        - normal:np.array := the normal of the applicator in the patient coordinate system. this is used for RapidBrachy only.
 35
 36    Functions:
 37        - load_stl(pth_input:str)
 38        - load_json(pth_input:str)
 39        - to_dict()
 40        - to_json(pth_output:str)
 41    """
 42
 43    def __init__(
 44        self,
 45        pth_input_file: str,
 46        material: str = None,
 47        density: float = None,
 48        origin: np.array = None,
 49        rotation: np.array = None,
 50        rotation_origin: np.array = None,
 51        coordinates: np.array = None,
 52        normal: np.array = None,
 53        catheter_trajectory: list = None,
 54    ) -> None:
 55        """
 56        Purpose:
 57            - Initialize the Applicator object.
 58        Inputs:
 59            - pth_input_file (str): The path to the input file.
 60            - material (str, optional): The material of the applicator. Defaults to None.
 61            - density (float, optional): The density of the applicator. Defaults to None.
 62            - origin (np.array, optional): The origin of the applicator in [x,y,z] . Defaults to None.
 63            - rotation (np.array, optional): The rotation vector of the applicator in [w,x,y,z]. Defaults to None.
 64            - rotation_origin (np.array, optional): The origin point with respect to which the rotaion vector is created.
 65            - coordinates (np.array, optional): The coordinates of the applicator in patient frame. Defaults to None.
 66            - normal (np.array, optional): The normal of the applicator in the patient frame. Defaults to None.
 67            - catheter_trajectory: (list, optional): The list of start dwell poisition and end dwell position of the catheter inside
 68            the applicator [[x,y,z,x,y,z]]. Defaults to None.
 69        Outputs:
 70            - None: an applicator object is created dependeing on the inputs.
 71        """
 72        assert os.path.exists(
 73            pth_input_file
 74        ), f"input file {pth_input_file} does not exist"
 75        self.path = pth_input_file
 76        self.name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(self.path))[0]
 77        self.applicator_mesh: vtkPolyData = None
 78        self.verticies: np.array = None
 79        self.faces: np.array = None
 80        self.origin: np.array = np.array([0, 0, 0])  # [x, y, z]
 81        self.rotation: np.array = np.array([0, 0, 0, 0])  # [w, x, y, z]
 82        self.coordinates: np.array = np.array([0, 0, 0])  # [x, y, z]
 83        self.material: str = None
 84        self.density: float = None
 85        self.normal: np.array = None
 86        self.catheter_trajectory: np.array = None
 87
 88        input_extension = os.path.splitext(self.path)[1]
 89        if input_extension == ".stl":
 90            self.load_stl(self.path)
 91        elif input_extension == ".json":
 92            self.load_json(self.path)
 93        else:
 94            raise ValueError("invalid input file extension")
 95
 96        if material is not None:
 97            self.material = material
 98        if density is not None:
 99            self.density = density
100        if origin is not None:
101            self.set_origin(origin)
102        if rotation is not None and rotation_origin is not None:
103            self.set_rotation(rotation, rotation_origin)
104        if coordinates is not None:
105            self.set_coordinates(coordinates)
106        if normal is not None:
107            self.normal = normal
108        if catheter_trajectory is not None:
109            self.catheter_trajectory = catheter_trajectory
110
111    def load_stl(self, pth_input: str) -> None:
112        r"""
113        Purpose:
114            - To load the applicator geometry from an stl file.
115        Inputs:
116            - pth_input:str := path to the stl file containing the applicator geometry.
117        Outputs:
118            - None := will update the BrachyApplicator object based on the stl file.
119        """
120        reader = vtkSTLReader()
121        reader.SetFileName(pth_input)
122        reader.Update()
123        self.applicator_mesh = reader.GetOutput()
124        self._update_brachy_applicator_from_applicator_mesh()
125
126    def load_json(self, pth_input: str) -> None:
127        r"""
128        Purpose:
129            - To load the applicator geometry from a json file.
130        Inputs:
131            - pth_input:str := path to the stl file containing the applicator geometry.
132        Outputs:
133            - None := will update the BrachyApplicator object based on the json file.
134        """
135        with open(pth_input, "r") as json_file:
136            applicator_dict = json.load(json_file)
137
138        self.verticies = np.array(applicator_dict["verticies"], dtype=np.float32)
139        self.faces = np.array(applicator_dict["faces"], dtype=np.int32)
140        self.set_origin(np.array(applicator_dict["origin"]))
141        self.set_rotation(np.array(applicator_dict["rotation"]))
142        self.set_coordinates(np.array(applicator_dict["coordinates"]))
143        self.material = applicator_dict["material"]
144        self.density = applicator_dict["density"]
145

169    def is_equal(self, other) -> bool:
170        r"""
171        Purpose:
172            - To compare the current applicator with another applicator.
173        Inputs:
174            - other:BrachyApplicator := the other applicator to compare with.
175        Outputs:
176            - bool := True if the two applicators are equal, False otherwise.
177        """
178        if type(self) is not type(other):
179            return False
180        if self.name != other.name:
181            return False
182        if not np.isclose(self.verticies, other.verticies, atol=1e-6).all():
183            return False
184        if not np.isclose(self.faces, other.faces, atol=1e-6).all():
185            return False
186        if not np.isclose(self.origin, other.origin, atol=1e-6).all():
187            return False
188        if not np.isclose(self.rotation, other.rotation, atol=1e-6).all():
189            return False
190        if self.material != other.material:
191            return False
192        if self.density != other.density:
193            return False
194        return True
195
196    def _update_applicator_mesh_from_brachy_applicator(self) -> None:
197        r"""
198        Purpose:
199            - To update the applicator mesh from the verticies and faces.
200        Inputs:
201            - self := the BrachyApplicator object.
202        Outputs:
203            - None := will update the applicator mesh from the verticies and faces.
204        """
205        points = vtkPoints()
206        for vertex in self.verticies:
207            points.InsertNextPoint(vertex)
208        self.applicator_mesh.SetPoints(points)
209
210        cell_array = vtkCellArray()
211        for face in self.faces:
212            cell_array.InsertNextCell(3, face)
213        self.applicator_mesh.SetPolys(cell_array)
214        fill_holes_filter = vtkFillHolesFilter()
215        fill_holes_filter.SetInputData(self.applicator_mesh)
216        fill_holes_filter.Update()
217        self.applicator_mesh = fill_holes_filter.GetOutput()
218
219    def _update_brachy_applicator_from_applicator_mesh(self) -> None:
220        r"""
221        Purpose:
222            - To update the brachy applicator from the applicator mesh.
223        Inputs:
224            - self := the BrachyApplicator object.
225        Outputs:
226            - None := will update the brachy applicator from the applicator mesh.
227        """
228        self.verticies = numpy_support.vtk_to_numpy(
229            self.applicator_mesh.GetPoints().GetData()
230        )
231        self.faces = numpy_support.vtk_to_numpy(
232            self.applicator_mesh.GetPolys().GetData()
233        )
234        self.faces = self.faces.reshape(-1, 4)[:, 1:]
235
236    def set_origin(self, origin: np.array) -> None:
237        r"""
238        Purpose:
239            - To set the origin of the applicator.
240        Inputs:
241            - origin:np.array := the origin of the applicator.
242        Outputs:
243            - None := will update the applicator verticies based on the new origin.
244        """
245        old_origin = self.origin
246        change_in_origin = np.ones_like(self.verticies) * (origin - old_origin)
247        self.origin = origin
248        self.verticies += change_in_origin
249        self._update_applicator_mesh_from_brachy_applicator()
250
251    def set_rotation(
252        self, rotation: np.array, rotation_origin: np.array = None
253    ) -> None:
254        r"""
255        Purpose:
256            - To set the rotation of the applicator.
257            the rotation origin is assumed to be the origin of applicator. To rotate the
258            applicator around its center, coordinates of the center of applicator should
259            be provided. The rotation angle is the first element of the rotation vector. the rotation
260            axis is the last three elements of the rotation vector [w,x,y,z].
261        Inputs:
262            - rotation:np.array := the rotation of the applicator.
263            The rotation vector is in quaternion ([w, x, y, z]).
264            - rotation_origin:np.array := the origin of the rotation. if not provided, the
265            origin of the applicator will be used.
266        Outputs:
267            - None := will update the applicator verticies based on the new rotation.
268        """
269        # set the rotation attribute
270        self.rotation = rotation
271        # by default, the rotation origin is the origin of the applicator
272        # if rotation is provided, the applicator is translated to the rotation origin
273        # then it is rotated and translated back to the original position.
274        if rotation_origin is not None:
275            transform_translate = vtkTransform()
276            transform_translate.Translate(
277                -rotation_origin[0], -rotation_origin[1], -rotation_origin[2]
278            )
279            transform_translate_filter = vtkTransformPolyDataFilter()
280            transform_translate_filter.SetTransform(transform_translate)
281            transform_translate_filter.SetInputData(self.applicator_mesh)
282            transform_translate_filter.Update()
283            self.applicator_mesh = transform_translate_filter.GetOutput()
284
285        # # now apply the rotation
286        # create the transformation matrix
287        transform = vtkTransform()
288        transform.RotateWXYZ(rotation[0], rotation[1], rotation[2], rotation[3])
289
290        # apply the transformation
291        transform_filter = vtkTransformPolyDataFilter()
292        transform_filter.SetTransform(transform)
293        transform_filter.SetInputData(self.applicator_mesh)
294        transform_filter.Update()
295        self.applicator_mesh = transform_filter.GetOutput()
296
297        # if rotation origin is provided, translate the applicator back to the original position
298        if rotation_origin is not None:
299            transform_translate = vtkTransform()
300            transform_translate.Translate(
301                rotation_origin[0], rotation_origin[1], rotation_origin[2]
302            )
303            transform_translate_filter = vtkTransformPolyDataFilter()
304            transform_translate_filter.SetTransform(transform_translate)
305            transform_translate_filter.SetInputData(self.applicator_mesh)
306            transform_translate_filter.Update()
307            self.applicator_mesh = transform_translate_filter.GetOutput()
308
309        # update the BrachyApplicator based on the transformation
310        self._update_brachy_applicator_from_applicator_mesh()
311
312    def set_coordinates(self, coordinates: np.array) -> None:
313        r"""
314        Purpose:
315            - to located the applicator at a given coordinate with respect to
316            self.origin.
317        Inputs:
318            - coordinates:np.array := the coordinates of the applicator.
319        Outputs:
320            - None := will update the applicator verticies based on the new coordinates.
321        """
322        # set the coordinate attributes
323        self.coordinates = coordinates
324
325        # create transformation matrix
326        transform = vtkTransform()
327        transform.Translate(coordinates[0], coordinates[1], coordinates[2])
328
329        # apply the transformation
330        transform_filter = vtkTransformPolyDataFilter()
331        transform_filter.SetTransform(transform)
332        transform_filter.SetInputData(self.applicator_mesh)
333        transform_filter.Update()
334        self.applicator_mesh = transform_filter.GetOutput()
335
336        # update the BrachyApplicator based on the transformation
337        self._update_brachy_applicator_from_applicator_mesh()

376    def to_json(self, pth_output: str) -> None:
377        r"""
378        Purpose:
379            - To save the applicator geometry to a json file.
380        Inputs:

382        Outputs:

390    def to_mac(self, pth_output: str) -> None:
391        r"""
392        Purpose:
393            - To save the applicator geometry to a mac file.
394        Inputs:
395            - pth_output:str := path to the output mac file.
396        Outputs:
397            - None := will save the applicator geometry to a mac file.
398        """
399        macfile_string = ""
400
401        # add in the vertex info
402        float_formatter = "{:.3f}".format
403        for vertex in self.verticies:
404            macfile_string += f"/applicator/vertex {float_formatter(vertex[0])} {float_formatter(vertex[1])} {float_formatter(vertex[2])} mm\n"
405
406        # add in the face info
407        for face in self.faces:
408            macfile_string += f"/applicator/face {face[0]} {face[1]} {face[2]}\n"
409        # add in the material info
410        macfile_string += f"/applicator/material {self.material}\n"
411        # add in the density info
412        macfile_string += f"/applicator/density {self.density}\n"
413        # add in the origin info
414        macfile_string += "/applicator/xPosition 0 mm\n"
415        macfile_string += "/applicator/yPosition 0 mm\n"
416        macfile_string += "/applicator/zPosition 0 mm\n"
417        # add in rotation nfo
418        macfile_string += "/applicator/xRotation 0 deg\n"
419        macfile_string += "/applicator/yRotation 0 deg\n"
420        macfile_string += "/applicator/zRotation 0 deg\n"
421        # add in the done flag
422        macfile_string += "/applicator/done\n"
423
424        with open(pth_output, "w") as mac_file:
425            mac_file.write(macfile_string)
426
427    def to_stl(self, pth_output: str) -> None:
428        r"""
429        Purpose:
430            - To save the applicator geometry to an stl file.
431        Inputs:
432            - pth_output:str := path to the output stl file.
433        Outputs:
434            - None := will save the applicator geometry to an stl file.
435        """
436        self._update_applicator_mesh_from_brachy_applicator()
437        # write the polydata to an stl file
438        stl_writer = vtkSTLWriter()
439        stl_writer.SetFileName(pth_output)
440        stl_writer.SetInputData(self.applicator_mesh)
441        stl_writer.Write()

Attributes: - path:str := path to the applicator geometry file. - name:str := name of the applicator, which is taken as the basename of the path. - applicator_mesh := the vtk mesh of the applicator. - verticies:np.array := the verticies of the applicator mesh. - faces:np.array := the faces of the applicator mesh. - origin:np.array := the origin of the applicator. - rotation:np.array := the rotation of the applicator. - material:str := the material of the applicator. - density:float := the density of the applicator. - normal:np.array := the normal of the applicator in the patient coordinate system. this is used for RapidBrachy only.

 65            - coordinates (np.array, optional): The coordinates of the applicator in patient frame. Defaults to None.
 66            - normal (np.array, optional): The normal of the applicator in the patient frame. Defaults to None.
 67            - catheter_trajectory: (list, optional): The list of start dwell poisition and end dwell position of the catheter inside
 68            the applicator [[x,y,z,x,y,z]]. Defaults to None.
 69        Outputs:
 70            - None: an applicator object is created dependeing on the inputs.
 71        """
 72        assert os.path.exists(
 73            pth_input_file
 74        ), f"input file {pth_input_file} does not exist"
 75        self.path = pth_input_file
 76        self.name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(self.path))[0]
 77        self.applicator_mesh: vtkPolyData = None
 78        self.verticies: np.array = None
 79        self.faces: np.array = None
 80        self.origin: np.array = np.array([0, 0, 0])  # [x, y, z]
 81        self.rotation: np.array = np.array([0, 0, 0, 0])  # [w, x, y, z]
 82        self.coordinates: np.array = np.array([0, 0, 0])  # [x, y, z]
 83        self.material: str = None
 84        self.density: float = None
 85        self.normal: np.array = None
 86        self.catheter_trajectory: np.array = None
 87
 88        input_extension = os.path.splitext(self.path)[1]
 89        if input_extension == ".stl":
 90            self.load_stl(self.path)
 91        elif input_extension == ".json":
 92            self.load_json(self.path)
 93        else:
 94            raise ValueError("invalid input file extension")
 95
 96        if material is not None:
 97            self.material = material
 98        if density is not None:
 99            self.density = density
100        if origin is not None:
101            self.set_origin(origin)
102        if rotation is not None and rotation_origin is not None:
103            self.set_rotation(rotation, rotation_origin)
104        if coordinates is not None:
105            self.set_coordinates(coordinates)
106        if normal is not None:
107            self.normal = normal
108        if catheter_trajectory is not None:
109            self.catheter_trajectory = catheter_trajectory

Purpose: - Initialize the Applicator object. Inputs: - pth_input_file (str): The path to the input file. - material (str, optional): The material of the applicator. def is_equal(self, other) -> bool: 
169    def is_equal(self, other) -> bool:
170        r"""
171        Purpose:
172            - To compare the current applicator with another applicator.
173        Inputs:
174            - other:BrachyApplicator := the other applicator to compare with.
175        Outputs:
176            - bool := True if the two applicators are equal, False otherwise.
177        """
178        if type(self) is not type(other):
179            return False
180        if self.name != other.name:
181            return False
182        if not np.isclose(self.verticies, other.verticies, atol=1e-6).all():
183            return False
184        if not np.isclose(self.faces, other.faces, atol=1e-6).all():
185            return False
186        if not np.isclose(self.origin, other.origin, atol=1e-6).all():
187            return False
188        if not np.isclose(self.rotation, other.rotation, atol=1e-6).all():
189            return False
190        if self.material != other.material:
191            return False
192        if self.density != other.density:
193            return False
194        return True

Purpose: - To compare the current applicator with another applicator. Inputs: - other:BrachyApplicator := the other applicator to compare with. Outputs: - bool := True if the two applicators are equal, False otherwise.

def set_origin(self, origin: <built-in function array>) -> None: 
236    def set_origin(self, origin: np.array) -> None:
237        r"""
238        Purpose:
239            - To set the origin of the applicator.
240        Inputs:
241            - origin:np.array := the origin of the applicator.
242        Outputs:
243            - None := will update the applicator verticies based on the new origin.
244        """
245        old_origin = self.origin
246        change_in_origin = np.ones_like(self.verticies) * (origin - old_origin)
247        self.origin = origin
248        self.verticies += change_in_origin
249        self._update_applicator_mesh_from_brachy_applicator()

Purpose: - To set the origin of the applicator. Inputs: - origin:np.array := the origin of the applicator. Outputs: - None := will update the applicator verticies based on the new origin.

def set_rotation( self, rotation: <built-in function array>, rotation_origin: <built-in function array> = None) -> None: 
251    def set_rotation(
252        self, rotation: np.array, rotation_origin: np.array = None
253    ) -> None:
254        r"""
255        Purpose:
256            - To set the rotation of the applicator.
257            the rotation origin is assumed to be the origin of applicator. To rotate the
258            applicator around its center, coordinates of the center of applicator should
259            be provided. The rotation angle is the first element of the rotation vector. the rotation
260            axis is the last three elements of the rotation vector [w,x,y,z].
261        Inputs:
262            - rotation:np.array := the rotation of the applicator.
263            The rotation vector is in quaternion ([w, x, y, z]).
264            - rotation_origin:np.array := the origin of the rotation. if not provided, the
265            origin of the applicator will be used.
266        Outputs:
267            - None := will update the applicator verticies based on the new rotation.
268        """
269        # set the rotation attribute
270        self.rotation = rotation
271        # by default, the rotation origin is the origin of the applicator
272        # if rotation is provided, the applicator is translated to the rotation origin
273        # then it is rotated and translated back to the original position.
274        if rotation_origin is not None:
275            transform_translate = vtkTransform()
276            transform_translate.Translate(
277                -rotation_origin[0], -rotation_origin[1], -rotation_origin[2]
278            )
279            transform_translate_filter = vtkTransformPolyDataFilter()
280            transform_translate_filter.SetTransform(transform_translate)
281            transform_translate_filter.SetInputData(self.applicator_mesh)
282            transform_translate_filter.Update()
283            self.applicator_mesh = transform_translate_filter.GetOutput()
284
285        # # now apply the rotation
286        # create the transformation matrix
287        transform = vtkTransform()
288        transform.RotateWXYZ(rotation[0], rotation[1], rotation[2], rotation[3])
289
290        # apply the transformation
291        transform_filter = vtkTransformPolyDataFilter()
292        transform_filter.SetTransform(transform)
293        transform_filter.SetInputData(self.applicator_mesh)
294        transform_filter.Update()
295        self.applicator_mesh = transform_filter.GetOutput()
296
297        # if rotation origin is provided, translate the applicator back to the original position
298        if rotation_origin is not None:
299            transform_translate = vtkTransform()
300            transform_translate.Translate(
301                rotation_origin[0], rotation_origin[1], rotation_origin[2]
302            )
303            transform_translate_filter = vtkTransformPolyDataFilter()
304            transform_translate_filter.SetTransform(transform_translate)
305            transform_translate_filter.SetInputData(self.applicator_mesh)
306            transform_translate_filter.Update()
307            self.applicator_mesh = transform_translate_filter.GetOutput()
308
309        # update the BrachyApplicator based on the transformation
310        self._update_brachy_applicator_from_applicator_mesh()

Purpose: - To set the rotation of the applicator. the rotation origin is assumed to be the origin of applicator. To rotate the applicator around its center, coordinates of the center of applicator should be provided. The rotation angle is the first element of the rotation vector. the rotation axis is the last three elements of the rotation vector [w,x,y,z]. Inputs: - rotation:np.array := the rotation of the applicator. The rotation vector is in quaternion ([w, x, y, z]). - rotation_origin:np.array := the origin of the rotation. if not provided, the origin of the applicator will be used. Outputs: - None := will update the applicator verticies based on the new rotation.

def to_mac(self, pth_output: str) -> None: 
390    def to_mac(self, pth_output: str) -> None:
391        r"""
392        Purpose:
393            - To save the applicator geometry to a mac file.
394        Inputs:
395            - pth_output:str := path to the output mac file.
396        Outputs:
397            - None := will save the applicator geometry to a mac file.
398        """
399        macfile_string = ""
400
401        # add in the vertex info
402        float_formatter = "{:.3f}".format
403        for vertex in self.verticies:
404            macfile_string += f"/applicator/vertex {float_formatter(vertex[0])} {float_formatter(vertex[1])} {float_formatter(vertex[2])} mm\n"
405
406        # add in the face info
407        for face in self.faces:
408            macfile_string += f"/applicator/face {face[0]} {face[1]} {face[2]}\n"
409        # add in the material info
410        macfile_string += f"/applicator/material {self.material}\n"
411        # add in the density info
412        macfile_string += f"/applicator/density {self.density}\n"
413        # add in the origin info
414        macfile_string += "/applicator/xPosition 0 mm\n"
415        macfile_string += "/applicator/yPosition 0 mm\n"
416        macfile_string += "/applicator/zPosition 0 mm\n"
417        # add in rotation nfo
418        macfile_string += "/applicator/xRotation 0 deg\n"
419        macfile_string += "/applicator/yRotation 0 deg\n"
420        macfile_string += "/applicator/zRotation 0 deg\n"
421        # add in the done flag
422        macfile_string += "/applicator/done\n"
423
424        with open(pth_output, "w") as mac_file:
425            mac_file.write(macfile_string)

Purpose: - To save the applicator geometry to a mac file. Inputs: - pth_output:str := path to the output mac file. Outputs: - None := will save the applicator geometry to a mac file.

class BrachyPhantom: 
  50class BrachyPhantom:
  51    r"""
  52    ### Puprose:
  53    - A class to load any voxelized geometry related to an HDR brachytherapy patient or phantom
  54        and perform some operations.
  55    ### Attributes:
  56    - pth_image: Path := the path of the geometry source file or files.
  57    - image_obj: CTImage or MRImage := the image of the patient loaded by openTPS. [x, y, z]
  58    - image_modality: Literal["CT", "MR", "US", "PET"] := the modality of the image.
  59    - structure_set: RTStruct := the structure set of the patient loaded by openTPS. [x, y, z].
  60    Other names for structure are contours, masks, segmentations.
  61    - cached_structure_masks: Dict[str, np.ndarray] := a cache for the structure masks.
  62    - structure_names: List[str] := the names of the structures in the dicom file.
  63    - unit_length: Literal["mm"] := the unit of length in the dicom file. default is mm.
  64    - xyz_format: bool := the format of the image. if True, the image is in [z, y, x] format.
  65    - orientation: Literal["LAS", "RAS", "LPS"] := the orientation of the image. default is LPS, same as 
  66    DICOM and slicer.
  67    ### Dependencies:
  68    - openTPS.core
  69    """
  70
  71    def __init__(
  72        self,
  73        dir_dicom: Optional[Path] = None,
  74        pth_phantom_file: Optional[Path] = None,
  75        pth_structures_file: Optional[Path] = None,
  76        pth_egsphant_file: Optional[Path] = None,
  77        image_obj: Optional[Image3D] = None,
  78        structure_set: Optional[
  79            RTStruct | Dict[str, Union[ROIMask, np.ndarray, ROIContour]]
  80            ] = None,
  81    ) -> None:
  82        r"""
  83        ### Purpose:
  84        - Initialize the BrachyPhantom class based on the input path. The input path can be either
  85        the directory of the DICOM files or the path of the phantom file (in .nrrd). The structures file
  86        is optional. It is also possible to load the structures only without a phantom file. in that case,
  87        an empty image_obj is created with the dimensions matching the structures file.
  88        ### Inputs:
  89        - dir_dicom: Path := the directory of the DICOM files.
  90        - pth_phantom_file: Path := the path of the phantom .nrrd file.
  91        - pth_structures_file: Path := the path of the structure file.
  92        - pth_egsphant_file: Path := the path of the Egsphant file to be loaded.
  93        note that it is possible to generate an Egsphant from BrachyPhantom object.
  94        ### Outputs:
  95        - None
  96        ### Dependencies:
  97        - openTPS.core
  98        - BrachyEgsphant
  99        """
 100        if sum(x is not None for x in [dir_dicom, pth_phantom_file, image_obj]) > 1:
 101            raise ValueError(
 102                "Please provide only one geometry source file. \
 103Please provide either the directory of the DICOM files, \
 104the path of the phantom file, or the path of the Egsphant file."
 105            )
 106        if sum(x is not None for x in [structure_set, pth_structures_file]) > 1:
 107            raise ValueError(
 108                "Please provide only one structure source file. \
 109Please provide either the structure_set or the path of the structure file."
 110            )
 111        # Attributes for patient images
 112        if dir_dicom is not None:
 113            self.pth_image: Path = Path(dir_dicom)
 114        elif pth_phantom_file is not None:
 115            self.pth_image: Path = Path(pth_phantom_file)
 116        else:
 117            self.pth_image = None
 118        self.image_obj: Union[CTImage, MRImage] = None
 119        self.image_modality: Literal["CT", "MR", "US"] = None
 120        self.structure_set = RTStruct()
 121        self.structure_names: List[str] = []
 122        # Used to avoid creating masks from contour multiple times, optional.
 123        # User needs to manually create the cache if they want to reuse it as a class attribute.
 124        self.cached_structure_masks: Dict[str, ROIMask] = None
 125        self.unit_length: Literal["mm"] = "mm"
 126        self.xyz_format: bool = True
 127        self.anatomical_coordinate_system: Literal["LAS", "RAS", "LPS"] = "LPS"
 128        # Attributes for Egsphant files
 129        from brachyutils.geometry.egsphant_utils import BrachyEgsphant
 130
 131        self.egsphant_obj: "BrachyEgsphant" = None
 132
 133        if dir_dicom is not None:
 134            self._load_dicom_image_files(self.pth_image)
 135        elif pth_phantom_file is not None:
 136            if str(pth_phantom_file).endswith(".nrrd"):
 137                self._load_nrrd_image_file(self.pth_image)
 138            elif str(pth_phantom_file).endswith(".nii.gz"):
 139                self._load_nifti_image_file(self.pth_image)
 140        elif pth_egsphant_file is not None:
 141            self.egsphant_obj = BrachyEgsphant(pth_egsphant_file=pth_egsphant_file)
 142        elif image_obj is not None:
 143            self.image_obj = image_obj
 144        else:
 145            warnings.warn("No geometry source file provided. Creating an empty Phantom", stacklevel=2)
 146
 147        if pth_structures_file is not None:
 148            pth_structures_file = Path(pth_structures_file)
 149            assert os.path.exists(pth_structures_file), "The input path does not exist."
 150            self._load_structure_file(pth_structures_file)
 151        elif structure_set is not None:
 152            if isinstance(structure_set, RTStruct):
 153                self.structure_set = structure_set
 154            else:
 155                self.set_structure_set(structure_set)
 156
 157        if pth_egsphant_file is not None:
 158            self.egsphant_obj = BrachyEgsphant(pth_egsphant_file=pth_egsphant_file)
 159
 160    def _load_dicom_image_files(self, pth_image: Path) -> None:
 161        r"""
 162        Purpose:
 163            - Load the DICOM image files.
 164        Inputs:
 165            - pth_image: Path := the path of the geometry source files.
 166        Outputs:
 167            - None
 168        Dependencies:
 169            - openTPS.core
 170        """
 171        assert os.path.exists(pth_image), "The input path does not exist."
 172        # Load the images only, RD, RS, RP files are not needed here.
 173        image_files = [file for file in glob((str(pth_image) + "/*.[Dd][Cc][Mm]"))
 174                       if not os.path.basename(file).startswith(("R", "r"))]
 175
 176        if len(image_files) == 0:
 177            raise ValueError("No DICOM files found in the input directory.")
 178        if "CT" in str(Path(image_files[0]).stem).upper():
 179            ct_files = list(filter(lambda s: "CT" in s.upper(), image_files))
 180            self.image_obj = readDicomCT(ct_files)
 181            self.image_modality = "CT"
 182            # get the orientation of the image
 183            header = pydicom.dcmread(ct_files[0])
 184            orientation = header.get((0x0010, 0x2210), "LPS")
 185            if orientation == "BIPED":
 186                orientation = "LPS"
 187            self.anatomical_coordinate_system = orientation if orientation is not None else "LPS"
 188        
 189        elif "MR" in  str(Path(image_files[0]).stem).upper():
 190            mr_files = list(filter(lambda s: "MR" in s.upper(), image_files))
 191            self.image_obj = readDicomMRI(mr_files)
 192            self.image_modality = "MR"
 193            header = pydicom.dcmread(mr_files[0])
 194            orientation = header.get((0x0010, 0x2210), "LPS")
 195            if orientation == "BIPED":
 196                orientation = "LPS"
 197            self.anatomical_coordinate_system = orientation if orientation is not None else "LPS"
 198
 199        elif "US" in str(Path(image_files[0]).stem).upper():
 200            us_files = list(filter(lambda s: "US" in s.upper(), image_files))
 201            self.image_obj = readDicomUS(us_files)
 202            self.image_modality = "US"
 203            header = pydicom.dcmread(us_files[0])
 204            orientation = header.get((0x0010, 0x2210), "LPS")
 205            if orientation == "BIPED":
 206                orientation = "LPS"
 207            self.anatomical_coordinate_system = orientation if orientation is not None else "LPS"
 208        elif "PT" in str(Path(image_files[0]).stem).upper():
 209            pet_files = list(filter(lambda s: "PT" in s.upper(), image_files))
 210            self.image_obj = readDicomPET(pet_files)
 211            self.image_modality = "PET"
 212            header = pydicom.dcmread(pet_files[0])
 213            orientation = header.get((0x0010, 0x2210), "LPS")
 214            if orientation == "BIPED":
 215                orientation = "LPS"
 216            self.anatomical_coordinate_system = orientation if orientation is not None else "LPS"            
 217        else:
 218            raise ValueError("The image modality is not recognized. the dicom file names should contain CT, MR or US.")
 219
 220    def _load_nrrd_image_file(self, pth_image: Path) -> None:
 221        r"""
 222        Purpose:
 223            - Load the NRRD image file.
 224        Inputs:
 225            - pth_image: Path := the path of the geometry source file.
 226        Outputs:
 227            - None
 228        Dependencies:
 229            - openTPS.core
 230        """
 231        assert os.path.exists(pth_image), "The input path does not exist."
 232        image_nrrd, header = nrrd.read(str(pth_image), index_order="C")
 233        origin = header["space origin"]
 234        affine = header["space directions"]
 235        spacing = affine.diagonal()
 236
 237        # get the orientation of the image:
 238        orientation = header.get("space", "LPS")
 239        # orientation could be in spelled out, let's convert it to the 3 letter format
 240        if "superior" in orientation.lower() or "inferior" in orientation.lower():
 241            char_list = []
 242            if "left" in orientation.lower():
 243                char_list.append("L")
 244            elif "right" in orientation.lower():
 245                char_list.append("R")
 246            if "anterior" in orientation.lower():
 247                char_list.append("A")
 248            elif "posterior" in orientation.lower():
 249                char_list.append("P")
 250            if "superior" in orientation.lower():
 251                char_list.append("S")
 252            elif "inferior" in orientation.lower():
 253                char_list.append("I")
 254            orientation = "".join(char_list)
 255
 256        modality = header.get("modality", "unknown")
 257        if modality == "unknown":
 258            if "ct" in pth_image.name.lower():
 259                modality = "CT"
 260            elif "mr" in pth_image.name.lower():
 261                modality = "MR"
 262            elif "us" in pth_image.name.lower():
 263                modality = "US"
 264            else:
 265                warnings.warn("The modality of the image is not recognized.")
 266
 267        self.image_obj = Image3D(
 268            origin=origin,
 269            spacing=spacing,
 270        )
 271        self.set_image_array(image_nrrd)
 272        self.image_obj.to_lps(current_orientation=orientation)
 273        self.anatomical_coordinate_system = "LPS"
 274        self.image_modality = modality
 275
 276    def _load_nifti_image_file(self, pth_image: Path) -> None:
 277        r"""
 278        Purpose:
 279            - Load the NIFTI image file.
 280        Inputs:
 281            - pth_image: Path := the path of the geometry source file.
 282        Outputs:
 283            - None
 284        Dependencies:
 285            - nibabel
 286        """
 287        import nibabel as nib
 288
 289        assert pth_image.exists(), "The input path does not exist."
 290        image_nifti = nib.load(self.pth_image)
 291        orientation = "".join(nib.aff2axcodes(image_nifti.affine))
 292        image_data = np.ascontiguousarray(image_nifti.get_fdata())
 293        origin = image_nifti.affine[:3, 3]
 294        spacing = image_nifti.header.get("pixdim")[1:4]
 295        origin = origin * [
 296            np.sign(image_nifti.affine[0][0]),
 297            np.sign(image_nifti.affine[1][1]),
 298            np.sign(image_nifti.affine[2][2]),
 299        ]
 300        if image_data.ndim == 4:
 301            image_data = image_data[:, :, :, 0]
 302        if image_nifti.header.data_layout == "F":
 303            image_data = np.swapaxes(image_data, 0, 2)
 304        # if image_nifti.header.default_x_flip:
 305            # image_data = np.flip(image_data, axis=2)
 306
 307
 308        self.image_modality = image_nifti.header.get("modality", "unknown")
 309        if self.image_modality == "unknown":
 310            if "ct" in self.pth_image.name.lower():
 311                self.image_modality = "CT"
 312            elif "mr" in self.pth_image.name.lower():
 313                self.image_modality = "MR"
 314            elif "us" in self.pth_image.name.lower():
 315                self.image_modality = "US"
 316            else:
 317                warnings.warn("The modality of the image is not recognized.")
 318
 319        self.image_obj = Image3D(
 320            origin=origin,
 321            spacing=spacing,
 322        )
 323        self.set_image_array(image_data)
 324        self.image_obj.to_lps(current_orientation=orientation)
 325        self.anatomical_coordinate_system = "LPS"
 326
 327    def _load_structure_file(self, pth_structure: Path) -> None:
 328        r"""
 329        Purpose:
 330            - Load the structure file.
 331        Inputs:
 332            - pth_structure: Path := the path of the structure source file.
 333        Outputs:
 334            - None
 335        Dependencies:
 336            - openTPS.core
 337        """
 338        # structure_file_type = "".join(pth_structure.suffixes)
 339        if str(pth_structure).endswith(".dcm"):
 340            self.structure_set = readDicomStruct(pth_structure)
 341            header = pydicom.dcmread(pth_structure)
 342            structure_orientation = header.get((0x0010, 0x2210), "LPS")
 343            if structure_orientation == "BIPED":
 344                structure_orientation = "LPS"
 345            self._update_structure_names()
 346            return
 347            # self.anatomical_coordinate_system = orientation
 348        elif str(pth_structure).endswith(".nrrd"):
 349            structure_mask_dict, structure_orientation = readNrrdStruct(pth_structure)
 350        elif str(pth_structure).endswith(".nii.gz"):
 351            structure_mask_dict, structure_orientation = readNiftiStruct(pth_structure)
 352        else:
 353            raise ValueError("The structure file type is not recognized.")
 354
 355        if self.anatomical_coordinate_system is None:
 356            self.anatomical_coordinate_system = structure_orientation
 357        else:
 358            assert (self.anatomical_coordinate_system == structure_orientation), \
 359                "The orientation of the structure file is not the same as the image file."
 360
 361        self.set_structure_set(structure_mask_dict)
 362
 363        # self.structure_names = []
 364        # for structure in self.structure_set.contours:
 365        #     self.structure_names.append(structure.name)
 366
 367    def get_structure_mask(
 368        self,
 369        query_structure_list: List[str],
 370        mask_type: Union[np.ndarray, ROIContour, ROIMask, str] = ROIMask,
 371        strict_name_match: bool = True,
 372    ) -> Dict[str, Union[np.ndarray, ROIContour, ROIMask]]:
 373        r"""
 374        ### Purpose:
 375        - To return a dictionary with the requested structure masks from BrachyPhantom object. The queried
 376        structure string should be a subset of the structure string in the dicom file. For example,
 377        if the structure string in dicom file is CTV_BRACHY, then the query string can be CTV or ctv.
 378        The keys in the dictionary match the query_structure_list and the values are the masks.
 379        ### Inputs:
 380        - query_structure_list := list of structure names to find the mask of.
 381        - mask_type: Union[np.ndarray, ROIContour, ROIMask] := the type of the mask to return.
 382            if np.ndarray (or str "array"), the mask will be returned as a numpy array in [z, y, x] format.
 383            if ROIContour (or str "contour"), the mask will be returned as a ROIContour object in [x, y, z] format.
 384            if ROIMask (or str "mask"), the mask will be returned as a ROIMask object in [x, y, z] format.
 385        ### Outputs:
 386        - mask_dict:dict :=  a dictionary with the queried structure name as key and the mask as value.
 387        """
 388        assert (
 389            self.structure_set is not None
 390        ), "structure masks have not been loaded yet. please run load_structure_file() first"
 391        mask_dict: dict = {}
 392        flattened_query_structure_list = []
 393      
 394        for query_structure in query_structure_list:
 395            if isinstance(query_structure, list):
 396                flattened_query_structure_list.extend(query_structure)
 397            else:
 398                flattened_query_structure_list.append(query_structure)
 399
 400        for query_structure in flattened_query_structure_list:
 401            for mask_name in self.structure_names:
 402                if strict_name_match:
 403                    pick_structure = query_structure.lower() == mask_name.lower()
 404                else:
 405                    pick_structure = query_structure.lower() in mask_name.lower()
 406                if pick_structure:
 407                    mask = self.structure_set.getContourByName(mask_name).getBinaryMask(
 408                        origin=self.image_obj.origin,
 409                        gridSize=self.image_obj.gridSize,
 410                        spacing=self.image_obj.spacing,
 411                    )
 412                    if not np.any(mask.imageArray):
 413                        warnings.warn(
 414                            f"mask for {query_structure} is all zeros",
 415                            stacklevel=2
 416                        )
 417                        mask.imageArray = np.zeros(self.image_obj.gridSize)
 418                        mask.origin = self.image_obj.origin
 419                        mask.spacing = self.image_obj.spacing
 420                        mask.gridSize = self.image_obj.gridSize
 421                    if mask_type == np.ndarray or mask_type == "array":
 422                        mask_dict[query_structure] = np.swapaxes(
 423                            mask.imageArray, 0, 2
 424                        )
 425                    elif mask_type == ROIContour or mask_type == "contour":
 426                        mask_dict[query_structure] = (
 427                            self.structure_set.getContourByName(mask_name)
 428                        )
 429                    elif mask_type == ROIMask or mask_type == "mask":
 430                        mask_dict[query_structure] = mask
 431                    else:
 432                        raise ValueError(f"mask_type {mask_type} not recognized")
 433        return mask_dict

 506    def is_equal(self, other: "BrachyPhantom") -> bool:
 507        r"""
 508        Purpose:
 509            - Check if two BrachyPhantom objects have equal image_obj.
 510        Inputs:
 511            - other: BrachyPhantom := the other BrachyPhantom object.
 512        Outputs:
 513            - bool := True if the two objects are equal, False otherwise.
 514        """
 515        if not isinstance(other, BrachyPhantom):
 516            warnings.warn(
 517                "The input object is not a BrachyPhantom object.", stacklevel=2
 518            )
 519            return False
 520        elif not self.image_modality == other.image_modality:
 521            warnings.warn("The image modalities are not the same.", stacklevel=2)
 522            return False
 523        elif not self.unit_length == other.unit_length:
 524            warnings.warn("The unit lengths are not the same.", stacklevel=2)
 525            return False
 526        elif not np.array_equal(self.image_obj.imageArray, other.image_obj.imageArray):
 527            warnings.warn("The image arrays are not the same.", stacklevel=2)
 528            return False
 529        elif self.structure_set is not None and other.structure_set is not None:
 530            for structure_name in self.structure_names:
 531                if self.structure_set.getContourByName(
 532                    structure_name
 533                ) != other.structure_set.getContourByName(structure_name):
 534                    warnings.warn(
 535                        f"The structure masks for {structure_name} are not the same.",
 536                        stacklevel=2,
 537                    )
 538                    return False
 539        else:
 540            return True
 541
 542    def get_image_array(self) -> np.ndarray:
 543        r"""

 556    def write_image_to_dicom(self, dir_output: Path) -> None:
 557        r"""
 558        Purpose:
 559            - To write the image and the dose to a dicom file.
 560        """
 561        if self.image_obj is not None:
 562            os.makedirs(dir_output, exist_ok=True)
 563            if self.image_modality == "CT":
 564                writeDicomCT(self.image_obj, str(dir_output))
 565            elif self.image_modality == "MR":
 566                warnings.warn("MR image writing is not implemented yet. writing volume as CT")
 567                writeDicomCT(self.image_obj, str(dir_output))
 568            elif self.image_modality == "US":
 569                warnings.warn("MR image writing is not implemented yet. writing volume as CT")
 570                writeDicomCT(self.image_obj, str(dir_output))
 571            else:
 572                raise ValueError("Image modality not recognized")
 573
 574    def write_structures_to_dicom(self, dir_output: Path) -> None:
 575        r"""
 576        Purpose:
 577            - To write the structures to a dicom file.
 578        """
 579        if self.structure_set is not None and len(self.structure_set.contours) > 0:
 580            os.makedirs(dir_output, exist_ok=True)
 581            writeRTStruct(self.structure_set, str(dir_output))

 583    def write_image_to_nrrd(
 584        self,
 585        pth_output: Path | str,
 586        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
 587        ) -> None:
 588        r"""
 589        Purpose:
 590            - To write the image to a nrrd file. By default, all images are written as Left Posterior Superior.
 591        Inputs:
 592            - pth_output: Path := the path to write the image to.
 593            - metadata := a dictionary containing the following meta data key values (should be changed later):
 594                "cancer site":
 595                "care center":
 596                "number of dwell positions":
 597                "number of segmented structures":
 598                "patient number":
 599                "Image content": "[3D dose, 3D uncertainty]"
 600        Outputs:
 601            - None
 602        Dependencies:
 603            - pynrrd
 604        """
 605        if isinstance(pth_output, str):
 606            pth_output = Path(pth_output)
 607        assert (
 608            os.path.splitext(pth_output)[-1] == ".nrrd"
 609        ), "the file should have '.nrrd' extension"
 610        imageToNrrd(
 611            image_obj=self.image_obj,
 612            pth_output=Path(pth_output),
 613            # anatomical_coordinate_system=self.anatomical_coordinate_system,
 614            modality=self.image_modality,
 615            metadata=metadata,
 616        )
 617
 618    def write_structures_to_nrrd(
 619        self,
 620        pth_output: Path | str,
 621        overlap: Optional[bool] = True,
 622        representation: Literal["contour", "mask"] = "mask",
 623        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
 624    ) -> None:
 625        r"""
 626        Purpose:
 627            - To write the structures to a nrrd file. By defualt, we remove the overlap between the structures. the smaller structures
 628            overwrite the larger structures if there is an overlap.
 629        Inputs:
 630            - pth_output: Path := the path to write the structures to.
 631            - overlap: Optional[bool] := if True, the structures will be written with overlap, meaning each structure will be represented
 632            by a binary matrix with 1s and 0s. if False, the structures will be written without overlap, an integer is asigned to 
 633            each structure and all the structures are represented by a single volume.
 634            - metadata: Optional[Dict[str, str]] := a dictionary containing any meta data additional to the minimal required meta data.
 635        Outputs:
 636            - None
 637        Dependencies:
 638            - pynrrd
 639        """
 640        if isinstance(pth_output, str):
 641            pth_output = Path(pth_output)
 642        if representation == "mask":
 643            structure_mask_dict: Dict[str, ROIMask] = self.get_structure_mask(
 644                self.structure_names, mask_type=ROIMask
 645            )
 646            masksToNrrd(
 647                structure_mask_dict=structure_mask_dict,
 648                pth_output=pth_output,
 649                overlap=overlap,
 650                metadata=metadata,
 651            )
 652        elif representation == "contour":
 653            raise NotImplementedError(
 654                "Writing structures to nrrd in contour representation is not implemented yet."
 655            )
 656        else:
 657            raise ValueError(
 658                f"Format {representation} not recognized. Please use 'mask' or 'contour'."
 659            )
 660
 661    def write_to_egsphant(
 662        self,
 663        pth_output: Path,
 664        material_dict: dict | Path = None,
 665        assign_material_from_ct: bool = None,
 666        crop_by_contour: str | List[str] = None,
 667        marginInMM: float | List[float] = 0.0,
 668        resampled_spacing: List[float] = None,
 669        resampled_origin: List[float] = None,
 670        resample_phantom_base: Optional[bool] = True,
 671        background_material: Optional[str] = "Air",
 672        strict_name_match: bool = True,
 673    ) -> None:
 674        r"""
 675        ### Purpose:
 676        - Write the BrachyPhantom object to an Egsphant file.
 677        ### Inputs:
 678        - pth_output: Path := the path to write the Egsphant file to.
 679        - material_dict: dict | Path := the dictionary of the materials. if Path, the path to the material file.
 680        The dictionary contains the name of the elements for each voxel,
 681        and the following keys: [
 682            "density" := the density of the material in g/cm^3,
 683            "HU_limit" := the lower HU limit threshold of the material,
 684            "structure_name := {optional} the name of the structure in the dicom file that represents the material,"
 685        ]
 686        - assign_material_from_ct: bool := if True, the material will be assigned from the CT image.
 687        - crop_by_contour: str | List[str] := the name of the structure in the dicom file to crop the phantom by.
 688        If a list of names is provided, the union of the structures will be used to crop the phantom.
 689        - marginInMM: float := the margin in mm to add to the cropped phantom. default is 0.
 690        - resampled_spacing: List[float] := the spacing to resample the egsphant to.
 691        - background_material: Optional[str] := the name of the background material. default is "Air".
 692        """
 693        pth_output = Path(pth_output)
 694        if not str(pth_output).endswith(".egsphant") and not str(pth_output).endswith(".seq.nrrd"):
 695            raise ValueError("The output file should have '.egsphant' or '.seq.nrrd' extension.")
 696        #if the egsphant is already made, write it
 697        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(pth_output), exist_ok=True)
 698        if self.egsphant_obj is not None:
 699            if str(pth_output).endswith(".egsphant"):
 700                self.egsphant_obj.write_to_ctegsphant(pth_output)
 701            elif str(pth_output).endswith(".seq.nrrd"):
 702                self.egsphant_obj.write_to_nrrd(pth_output)
 703#prepare the phantom for egsphant conversion
 704        elif self.image_obj is not None:
 705            phantom_used_for_egsphant = deepcopy(self)
 706            from brachyutils.geometry.egsphant_utils import BrachyEgsphant
 707            
 708            if resampled_spacing is not None or resampled_origin is not None: #if we want to resample
 709                if resample_phantom_base: #resample the phantom and structures that the egsphant is based on
 710                    phantom_used_for_egsphant.resample_to(
 711                        origin=resampled_origin,
 712                        spacing=resampled_spacing,
 713                        inplace=True
 714                    )
 715
 716            self.egsphant_obj = BrachyEgsphant(
 717                phantom=phantom_used_for_egsphant,
 718                material_dict=material_dict,
 719                assign_material_from_ct=assign_material_from_ct,
 720                background_material=background_material
 721            )
 722  
 723            if crop_by_contour is not None:
 724                self.egsphant_obj.crop_by_contour(
 725                    phantom_used_for_egsphant,
 726                    crop_by_contour,
 727                    strict_name_match=strict_name_match,
 728                    marginInMM=marginInMM)
 729
 730            if resampled_spacing is not None and not resample_phantom_base:
 731                self.egsphant_obj.material_image = resampleImage3D(
 732                    image=self.egsphant_obj.material_image,
 733                    origin=resampled_origin,
 734                    spacing=resampled_spacing, 
 735                    outputType=np.int16)
 736                self.egsphant_obj.density_image = resampleImage3D(
 737                    image=self.egsphant_obj.density_image,
 738                    origin=resampled_origin,
 739                    spacing=resampled_spacing,)
 740                    # sitk_interpolator=sitk.sitkNearestNeighbor)
 741                self.egsphant_obj.get_voxel_edges()
 742            if str(pth_output).endswith(".egsphant"):
 743                self.egsphant_obj.write_to_ctegsphant(pth_output)
 744            elif str(pth_output).endswith(".seq.nrrd"):
 745                self.egsphant_obj.write_to_nrrd(pth_output)
 746        else:
 747            raise ValueError(
 748                "No image object or egsphant object to write to Egsphant file. Please load the image object first."
 749            )
 750
 751    def export_to(
 752        self,
 753        pth_image_out: Path | str = None,
 754        pth_structures_out: Path | str = None,
 755        dir_dicom_out: Path | str = None,
 756        dir_nrrd_out: Path | str = None
 757        ):
 758        r"""
 759        Purpose:
 760            - To export the image and/or the structures to file. This function will call the appropriate
 761            export function depending on the extension of the given path. If you would like to export
 762            to egsphant, please use write_to_egsphant() function.
 763        Inputs:
 764            pth_image_out:= path to the output image file. If the extension could be .nrrd. To export images
 765            to dicom, use dir_dicom_out.
 766            pth_structures_out:= path to the output structure file, the extension could be .nrrd or .dcm
 767            dir_dicom_out:= path to export all the dicom informatin to. it has to be a directory
 768        """
 769        if pth_image_out is not None:
 770            pth_image_out = Path(pth_image_out)
 771            assert self.image_obj is not None, "no image is loaded into this BrachyPhantom"
 772            if str(pth_image_out).endswith(".nrrd"):
 773                self.write_image_to_nrrd(pth_output=pth_image_out)
 774
 775        if pth_structures_out is not None:
 776            pth_structures_out = Path(pth_structures_out)
 777            assert self.structure_set is not None, "no structures is loaded into this BrachyPhantom"
 778            self.write_structures_to_nrrd(pth_output=pth_structures_out)
 779
 780        if dir_dicom_out is not None:
 781            dir_dicom_out = Path(dir_dicom_out)
 782            os.makedirs(dir_dicom_out, exist_ok=True)
 783            assert dir_dicom_out.is_dir(), f"the provided path {dir_dicom_out} is not a directory"
 784            if self.image_obj is not None:
 785                self.write_image_to_dicom(dir_output=dir_dicom_out)
 786            if self.structure_set is not None:
 787                self.write_structures_to_dicom(dir_output=dir_dicom_out)
 788
 789        if dir_nrrd_out is not None:
 790            dir_nrrd_out = Path(dir_nrrd_out)
 791            os.makedirs(dir_nrrd_out, exist_ok=True)
 792            assert dir_nrrd_out.is_dir(), f"the provided path {dir_nrrd_out} is not a directory"
 793            if self.image_obj is not None:
 794                self.write_image_to_nrrd(
 795                    pth_output=Path.joinpath(dir_nrrd_out, str(self.pth_image.name).split(".")[0]+".nrrd")
 796                    )
 797            if self.structure_set is not None and len(self.structure_set.contours) > 0:
 798                self.write_structures_to_nrrd(
 799                    pth_output=Path.joinpath(dir_nrrd_out, str(self.pth_image.name).split(".")[0]+".seg.nrrd")
 800                )
