 802    def crop_by_coordinates(
 803        self,
 804        coordinate_range: List[float] | np.array,
 805        inplace: "BrachyPhantom" = True,
 806        marginInMM: float | List[float] = 0.0,
 807    ) -> None:
 808        r"""
 809        Purpose:
 810            - Crop the phantom by the input coordinates.
 811        Inputs:
 812            - coordinate_range := a 3 x 2 array holding the min and max on x, y and z axis
 813                [[ix_min, ix_max], [iy_min, iy_max], [iz_min, iz_max]]
 814            - inplace := if True, the cropping will be done in place. if False, a new BrachyPhantom object will be returned.
 815        Outputs:
 816            - None
 817        """
 818        import copy
 819
 820        from opentps.core.processing.imageProcessing.resampler3D import (
 821            crop3DDataAroundBox,
 822        )
 823
 824        coordinate_range = np.array(coordinate_range)
 825        assert coordinate_range.shape == (
 826            3,
 827            2,
 828        ), "coordinate_range should be a 3x2 array in x, y, z order"
 829        if isinstance(marginInMM, float):
 830            marginInMM = [marginInMM]*3
 831        if inplace:
 832            crop3DDataAroundBox(self.image_obj, coordinate_range, marginInMM=marginInMM)
 833        else:
 834            new_phantom: BrachyPhantom = copy.deepcopy(self)
 835            new_phantom.crop_by_coordinates(coordinate_range, inplace=True, marginInMM=marginInMM)
 836            return new_phantom
 837
 838    def crop_by_index(
 839        self,
 840        index_range: List[int] | np.array,
 841        inplace: Optional[bool] = True,
 842        marginInMM: float | List[float] = 0.0,
 843    ) -> Union[None, "BrachyPhantom"]:
 844        r"""
 845        Purpose:
 846            - given a range of indicies (mix and max on each axis), this function will crop
 847            image_obj and will adjust the rest of the attributes accordingly.
 848        Inputs:
 849            - self: BrachyEgsphant object
 850            - index_range := a 3 x 2 array holding the min and max index on x, y and z axis
 851                [[ix_min, ix_max], [iy_min, iy_max], [iz_min, iz_max]]
 852            - inplace := if True, the cropping will be done in place. if False, a new BrachyPhantom object will be returned.
 853        Outputs:
 854            - None
 855        """
 856        assert index_range.shape == (
 857            3,
 858            2,
 859        ), "index_range should be a 3x2 array in x, y, z order"
 860        new_origin_coords = self.image_obj.getPositionFromVoxelIndex(
 861            index_range[:, 0]
 862        )
 863        new_ending_coords = self.image_obj.getPositionFromVoxelIndex(
 864            index_range[:, 1]
 865        )
 866        new_coords_range = np.column_stack([new_origin_coords, new_ending_coords])
 867        return self.crop_by_coordinates(new_coords_range, inplace, marginInMM=marginInMM)
 868
 869    def crop_by_contour(
 870        self,
 871        contour_name: str | List[str],
 872        inplace: bool = True,
 873        strict_name_match: bool = True,
 874        marginInMM: float | List[float] = 0.0,
 875    ) -> Union[None, "BrachyPhantom"]:
 876        r"""
 877        Purpose:
 878            - Crop the phantom by the input contours.
 879        Inputs:
 880            - contour_name: str := the name of the contour to crop by.
 881            - inplace: Optional[None | "BrachyPhantom"] := if True, the cropping will be done in place. if False, a new BrachyPhantom object will be returned.
 882        Outputs:
 883            - None
 884        """
 885        from opentps.core.processing.imageProcessing.resampler3D import (
 886            resampleImage3DOnImage3D,
 887        )
 888        from opentps.core.processing.segmentation.segmentation3D import getBoxAroundROI
 889        if isinstance(contour_name, str):
 890            contour_name = [contour_name]
 891        if isinstance(marginInMM, float):
 892            marginInMM = [marginInMM, marginInMM, marginInMM]
 893        mask_dict = self.get_structure_mask(
 894            contour_name,
 895            mask_type=ROIMask,
 896            strict_name_match=strict_name_match)
 897        combined_mask_array = np.zeros_like(
 898            mask_dict[contour_name[0]].imageArray, dtype=bool
 899        )
 900        for name in contour_name:
 901            combined_mask_array = np.logical_or(combined_mask_array, mask_dict[name].imageArray)
 902        combined_mask = ROIMask(
 903            imageArray=combined_mask_array,
 904            origin=self.image_obj.origin,
 905            spacing=self.image_obj.spacing,
 906        )
 907        resampled_mask = resampleImage3DOnImage3D(
 908            combined_mask, self.image_obj
 909        )
 910        box_around_mask = np.array(getBoxAroundROI(resampled_mask))
 911        return self.crop_by_coordinates(box_around_mask, inplace, marginInMM)
 912
 913    def cache_structure_set_as_masks(
 914        self,
 915        interpolator_contours=sitk.sitkNearestNeighbor,
 916        pth_structures_file: str | Path = None,
 917        mask_colors: Dict[str, Sequence[int]] | Sequence[int] = None,
 918    ) -> None:
 919        r"""
 920        Purpose:
 921            - Cache the structure set as masks. This will resample the masks to the image object.
 922            Function used in case you query multiple time the masks from the BrachyPhantom object
 923            and you want to avoid resampling the masks each time.
 924        Inputs:
 925            - interpolator_contours: sitk.InterpolatorEnum := the interpolator to use for resampling the contours.
 926        Outputs:
 927            - None
 928        """
 929        from opentps.core.processing.imageProcessing.resampler3D import resampleImage3DOnImage3D
 930
 931        if pth_structures_file is not None:
 932            assert pth_structures_file.endswith(".nrrd"), "the structure file should be a nrrd file"
 933            structure_dict, _ = readNrrdStruct(pth_structures_file)
 934        else:
 935            structure_dict = self.get_structure_mask(
 936                self.structure_names,
 937                mask_type=ROIMask,
 938                )
 939        slicer_colors = _get_slicer_colors()
 940        # set the default color dictionary if not provided
 941        if mask_colors is None:
 942            mask_colors = {
 943                k: slicer_colors[i+1]["color"] for i, k in enumerate(structure_dict.keys())
 944            }
 945        elif isinstance(mask_colors, Sequence):
 946            mask_colors = {
 947                k: mask_colors for k in structure_dict.keys()
 948            }
 949
 950        new_structure_dict = {}
 951        for struc in structure_dict.keys():
 952            mask = structure_dict[struc]
 953            old_color = mask._displayColor
 954            structure_color = mask_colors.get(struc)
 955            if not(old_color is None):
 956                new_color = old_color
 957            else:
 958                new_color = structure_color
 959            if not np.array_equal(mask.spacing, self.image_obj.spacing) or \
 960                not np.array_equal(mask.origin, self.image_obj.origin) or \
 961                not np.array_equal(mask.gridSize, self.image_obj.gridSize):
 962                new_structure_dict[struc] = resampleImage3DOnImage3D(
 963                    mask,
 964                    self.image_obj,
 965                    sitk_interpolator=interpolator_contours
 966                    )
 967            else:
 968                new_structure_dict[struc] = mask
 969            new_structure_dict[struc]._displayColor = new_color
 970        # Store the resampled masks in the cached_structure_masks attribute
 971        self.cached_structure_masks = new_structure_dict
 972
 973    def set_structure_set(
 974        self,
 975        mask_dict: Dict[str, Union[ROIMask, ROIContour, np.ndarray, sitk.Image]],
 976        mask_colors: Dict[str, Tuple[int, int, int]] | Tuple[int, int, int] = None,
 977        ) -> None:
 978        r"""
 979        ### Purpose:
 980        - Set the structure set with the input mask dictionary mapping structure names to ROIMask.
 981        If the name of a structure is in the structure set, the mask will be replaced.
 982        If the name of a structure is not in the structure set, a new structure will be added.
 983        The mask will be resampled to the image object if it exists.
 984        ### Inputs:
 985        - mask_dict: dict := the dictionary of the masks.
 986        - mask_colors: dict | tuple := the dictionary of the colors for each structure. If a tuple is provided,
 987        the same color will be used for all structures. If None is provided, the default colors will be used based
 988        on the slicer color table https://www.slicer.org/wiki/Slicer3:2010_GenericAnatomyColors.
 989        The values could be numpy arrays, ROIContour or ROIMask objects.
 990        ### Outputs:
 991        - None
 992        """
 993        from opentps.core.processing.imageProcessing.resampler3D import (
 994            resampleImage3DOnImage3D,
 995        )
 996        from opentps.core.processing.segmentation.segmentation3D import getBoxAroundROI
 997        slicer_colors = _get_slicer_colors()
 998        # set the default color dictionary if not provided
 999        if mask_colors is None:
1000            mask_colors = {
1001                k: slicer_colors[i+1]["color"] for i, k in enumerate(mask_dict.keys())
1002            }
1003        elif isinstance(mask_colors, Sequence):
1004            mask_colors = {
1005                k: mask_colors for k in mask_dict.keys()
1006            }
1007
1008        for structure_name in mask_dict:
1009            structure_color = mask_colors.get(structure_name)
1010            # check if the structure already exists in structure set
1011            old_structure = self.structure_set.getContourByName(structure_name)
1012            if old_structure is None:
1013                old_structure = self.structure_set.getContourByName(structure_name.upper())
1014            if old_structure is not None:
1015                self.structure_set.removeContour(old_structure)
1016                structure_color = old_structure.color
1017
1018            #print(f"setting structure {structure_name}, which is a {type(mask_dict[structure_name])} type")
1019            if mask_dict.get(structure_name) is None:
1020                continue
1021            if isinstance(mask_dict.get(structure_name), np.ndarray):
1022                mask = ROIMask(
1023                    name=structure_name,
1024                    imageArray=np.swapaxes(mask_dict[structure_name], 0, 2),
1025                    origin=self.image_obj.origin,
1026                    spacing=self.image_obj.spacing,
1027                )
1028            elif isinstance(mask_dict.get(structure_name), ROIContour):
1029                mask = mask_dict.get(structure_name).getBinaryMask(
1030                    origin=self.image_obj.origin,
1031                    spacing=self.image_obj.spacing,
1032                    gridSize=self.image_obj.gridSize,
1033                )
1034                mask.name = structure_name
1035
1036            elif isinstance(mask_dict.get(structure_name), ROIMask):
1037                mask = mask_dict.get(structure_name)
1038                mask.name = structure_name
1039                if self.image_obj is not None:
1040                    # Check if the spacings, the shape and origin already match or not
1041                    if not np.array_equal(mask.spacing, self.image_obj.spacing) or \
1042                        not np.array_equal(mask.origin, self.image_obj.origin) or \
1043                        not np.array_equal(mask.gridSize, self.image_obj.gridSize):
1044                        # Resample the mask to the image object
1045                        mask = resampleImage3DOnImage3D(mask, self.image_obj)   
1046            elif isinstance(mask_dict.get(structure_name), sitk.Image):
1047                mask = ROIMask(
1048                    name=structure_name,
1049                    imageArray=sitk.GetArrayFromImage(mask_dict[structure_name]),
1050                    origin=mask_dict[structure_name].GetOrigin(),
1051                    spacing=mask_dict[structure_name].GetSpacing(),
1052                )
1053            else:
1054                raise ValueError("The mask type is not recognized.")
1055 
1056            # if mask hits the boundary of the image, set the boundary to 0.
1057            tight_box_coordinates = np.round(getBoxAroundROI(mask), decimals=2)
1058            mask_edges = np.array(
1059                [
1060                    mask.getPositionFromVoxelIndex([0, 0, 0]),
1061                    mask.getPositionFromVoxelIndex(mask.gridSize-1)
1062                    ]
1063                )
1064            mask_edges = np.round(mask_edges, decimals=2)
1065            mask_edges = np.reshape(mask_edges.T, (3, 2))
1066            touching_edge = (tight_box_coordinates == mask_edges).flatten()
1067            for i, edge in enumerate(touching_edge):
1068                if edge:
1069                    if i == 0:
1070                        mask.imageArray[0, :, :] = 0
1071                    elif i == 1:
1072                        mask.imageArray[-1, :, :] = 0
1073                    elif i == 2:
1074                        mask.imageArray[:, 0, :] = 0
1075                    elif i == 3:
1076                        mask.imageArray[:, -1, :] = 0
1077                    # hitting the ends of the z axis is not problematic
1078                    # elif i == 4:
1079                    #     mask.imageArray[:, :, 0] = 0
1080                    # elif i == 5:
1081                        # mask.imageArray[:, :, -1] = 0
1082
1083            mask._displayColor = structure_color
1084            self.structure_set.appendContour(mask.getROIContour())
1085            del mask
1086
1087        self.structure_set.setPatient(
1088                self.image_obj.patient if self.image_obj is not None else None
1089            )
1090
1091        # self.structure_set.seriesInstanceUID = self.image_obj.seriesInstanceUID if self.structure_set is not None else ""
1092        # self.structure_set.sopInstanceUID = self.image_obj.sopInstanceUID if self.structure_set is None else ""
1093        self._update_structure_names()
1094
1095    def _update_structure_names(self) -> None:
1096        r"""
1097        Purpose:
1098            - Update the structure names based ont he structure set.
1099        Inputs:
1100            - None
1101        Outputs:
1102            - None
1103        """
1104        self.structure_names = [structure.name for structure in self.structure_set.contours]
1105
1106    def rename_structures(self, structure_name_dict: dict) -> None:
1107        r"""
1108        Purpose:
1109            - First purpose is to rename the structures in the structure set.
1110            - Additional purpose is to remove structures if their new name is 'REMOVE'.
1111        
1112        Inputs:
1113            - structure_name_dict: dict := the dictionary of the structure names to rename.
1114            The keys are the old names and the values are the new names.
1115        
1116        Outputs:
1117            - None
1118        """
1119        assert len(self.structure_set) > 0 or len(self.cached_structure_masks) > 0, (
1120            "No structures to rename. Please load the structures first."
1121        )
1122        if len(self.cached_structure_masks) > 0:
1123            new_cached_structure_masks = {}
1124            for old_name, new_name in structure_name_dict.items():
1125                if old_name in self.cached_structure_masks:
1126                    if new_name == "REMOVE":
1127                        continue
1128                    new_cached_structure_masks[new_name] = self.cached_structure_masks[old_name]
1129                else:
1130                    warnings.warn(f"The structure {old_name} does not exist in the cached masks.")
1131            self.cached_structure_masks = new_cached_structure_masks
1132            
1133        if len(self.structure_set) > 0:
1134            for old_name, new_name in structure_name_dict.items():
1135                if new_name == "REMOVE":
1136                    self.remove_structure(old_name)
1137                    continue
1138                structure = self.structure_set.getContourByName(old_name)
1139                if structure is not None:
1140                    structure.name = new_name
1141                else:
1142                    warnings.warn(f"The structure {old_name} does not exist.")
1143            self._update_structure_names()
1144    
1145    def remove_structure(self, structure_name: str) -> None:
1146        r"""
1147        Purpose:
1148            - Remove the structure from the structure set.
1149        Inputs:
1150            - structure_name: str := the name of the structure to remove.
1151        Outputs:
1152            - None
1153        """
1154        structure = self.structure_set.getContourByName(structure_name)
1155        if structure is not None:
1156            self.structure_set.removeContour(structure)
1157            self._update_structure_names()
1158        else:
1159            warnings.warn(f"The structure {structure_name} does not exist.")
1160
1161    def resample_to(
1162        self,
1163        origin:np.array=None,
1164        spacing:np.array=None,
1165        inplace:bool=True,
1166        gridSize:np.array=None,
1167        interpolator_img=sitk.sitkLinear, 
1168        interpolator_contours=sitk.sitkLinear) -> "BrachyPhantom":
1169        r"""
1170        ### Purpose:
1171            - resample the phantom to a new origin and spacing.
1172        
1173        ### Inputs:
1174            - origin:np.array := the new origin of the image.
1175            - spacing:np.array := the new spacing of the image.
1176            - inplace:bool := if True, the resampling will be done in place.
1177        
1178        ### Outputs:
1179            - BrachyPhantom := the resampled phantom object if the inplace is False
1180        """
1181        from opentps.core.processing.imageProcessing.resampler3D import resampleImage3D
1182        new_phantom = phantom_with_empty_image_like(self, new_pth_image=self.pth_image)
1183        new_img_obj = resampleImage3D(
1184            self.image_obj,
1185            origin=origin,
1186            spacing=spacing,
1187            gridSize=gridSize,
1188            sitk_interpolator=interpolator_img
1189            )
1190        
1191        if self.cached_structure_masks is not None and len(self.cached_structure_masks) > 0:
1192            new_cached_structure_masks = {}
1193            for structure_name, mask in self.cached_structure_masks.items():
1194                old_color = mask._displayColor
1195                new_cached_structure_masks[structure_name] = resampleImage3DOnImage3D(
1196                    mask,
1197                    new_img_obj,
1198                    sitk_interpolator=interpolator_contours
1199                    )
1200                new_cached_structure_masks[structure_name]._displayColor = old_color
1201            self.cached_structure_masks = new_cached_structure_masks
1202
1203        if inplace:
1204            self.image_obj = new_img_obj
1205        else:
1206            new_phantom.image_obj = new_img_obj
1207            return new_phantom
1208
1209    def sort_structures_by_name(self, sorted_names):
1210        r"""
1211        Purpose:
1212            - Sort the structures in the structure set by the input list of names.
1213        Inputs:
1214            - sorted_names: list := the list of names to sort the structures by.
1215        Outputs:
1216            - None
1217        """
1218        self.structure_set._contours = sorted(
1219            self.structure_set._contours,
1220            key=lambda x: sorted_names.index(x.name)
1221            if x.name in sorted_names
1222            else len(sorted_names)
1223        )
1224        self._update_structure_names()
1225
1226    def get_structures_volume(self, structure_names:List[str]) -> Dict[str, float]:
1227        r"""
1228        Purpose:
1229            - Get the volume of each structure that is requested.
1230        Inputs:
1231            - structure_names: list := the list of names of the structures to get the volumes for.
1232        Outputs:
1233            - volume_dict: dict := the dictionary of the volumes of each structure in cm^3.
1234        """
1235        assert self.image_obj is not None, "No image object to get the volume from."
1236        assert self.structure_set is not None, "No structure set to get the volume from."
1237        mask_dict = self.get_structure_mask(structure_names, mask_type=ROIMask)
1238        volume_dict = {}
1239        for name, mask in mask_dict.items():
1240            assert mask is not None, f"No mask found for structure {name}."
1241            volume_dict[name] = mask.getVolume()/1000 # convert to cm^3
1242        return volume_dict

Puprose:

  • A class to load any voxelized geometry related to an HDR brachytherapy patient or phantom and perform some operations.

    Attributes:

  • pth_image: Path := the path of the geometry source file or files.

  • image_obj: CTImage or MRImage := the image of the patient loaded by openTPS. [x, y, z]
  • image_modality: Literal["CT", "MR", "US", "PET"] := the modality of the image.
  • structure_set: RTStruct := the structure set of the patient loaded by openTPS. [x, y, z]. Other names for structure are contours, masks, segmentations.
  • cached_structure_masks: Dict[str, np.ndarray] := a cache for the structure masks.
  • structure_names: List[str] := the names of the structures in the dicom file.
  • unit_length: Literal["mm"] := the unit of length in the dicom file. default is mm.
  • xyz_format: bool := the format of the image. if True, the image is in [z, y, x] format.

  • orientation: Literal["LAS", "RAS", "LPS"] := the orientation of the image. default is LPS, same as DICOM and slicer.

    Dependencies:

  • openTPS.core

BrachyPhantom( dir_dicom: Optional[pathlib._local.Path] = None, pth_phantom_file: Optional[pathlib._local.Path] = None, pth_structures_file: Optional[pathlib._local.Path] = None, pth_egsphant_file: Optional[pathlib._local.Path] = None, image_obj: Optional[opentps.core.data.images._image3D.Image3D] = None, structure_set: Union[opentps.core.data._rtStruct.RTStruct, Dict[str, Union[opentps.core.data.images._roiMask.ROIMask, numpy.ndarray, opentps.core.data._roiContour.ROIContour]], NoneType] = None) 
 71    def __init__(
 72        self,
 73        dir_dicom: Optional[Path] = None,
 74        pth_phantom_file: Optional[Path] = None,
 75        pth_structures_file: Optional[Path] = None,
 76        pth_egsphant_file: Optional[Path] = None,
 77        image_obj: Optional[Image3D] = None,
 78        structure_set: Optional[
 79            RTStruct | Dict[str, Union[ROIMask, np.ndarray, ROIContour]]
 80            ] = None,
 81    ) -> None:
 82        r"""
 83        ### Purpose:
 84        - Initialize the BrachyPhantom class based on the input path. The input path can be either
 85        the directory of the DICOM files or the path of the phantom file (in .nrrd). The structures file
 86        is optional. It is also possible to load the structures only without a phantom file. in that case,
 87        an empty image_obj is created with the dimensions matching the structures file.
 88        ### Inputs:
 89        - dir_dicom: Path := the directory of the DICOM files.
 90        - pth_phantom_file: Path := the path of the phantom .nrrd file.
 91        - pth_structures_file: Path := the path of the structure file.
 92        - pth_egsphant_file: Path := the path of the Egsphant file to be loaded.
 93        note that it is possible to generate an Egsphant from BrachyPhantom object.
 94        ### Outputs:
 95        - None
 96        ### Dependencies:
 97        - openTPS.core
 98        - BrachyEgsphant
 99        """
100        if sum(x is not None for x in [dir_dicom, pth_phantom_file, image_obj]) > 1:
101            raise ValueError(
102                "Please provide only one geometry source file. \
103Please provide either the directory of the DICOM files, \
104the path of the phantom file, or the path of the Egsphant file."
105            )
106        if sum(x is not None for x in [structure_set, pth_structures_file]) > 1:
107            raise ValueError(
108                "Please provide only one structure source file. \
109Please provide either the structure_set or the path of the structure file."
110            )
111        # Attributes for patient images
112        if dir_dicom is not None:
113            self.pth_image: Path = Path(dir_dicom)
114        elif pth_phantom_file is not None:
115            self.pth_image: Path = Path(pth_phantom_file)
116        else:
117            self.pth_image = None
118        self.image_obj: Union[CTImage, MRImage] = None
119        self.image_modality: Literal["CT", "MR", "US"] = None
120        self.structure_set = RTStruct()
121        self.structure_names: List[str] = []
122        # Used to avoid creating masks from contour multiple times, optional.
123        # User needs to manually create the cache if they want to reuse it as a class attribute.
124        self.cached_structure_masks: Dict[str, ROIMask] = None
125        self.unit_length: Literal["mm"] = "mm"
126        self.xyz_format: bool = True
127        self.anatomical_coordinate_system: Literal["LAS", "RAS", "LPS"] = "LPS"
128        # Attributes for Egsphant files
129        from brachyutils.geometry.egsphant_utils import BrachyEgsphant
130
131        self.egsphant_obj: "BrachyEgsphant" = None
132
133        if dir_dicom is not None:
134            self._load_dicom_image_files(self.pth_image)
135        elif pth_phantom_file is not None:
136            if str(pth_phantom_file).endswith(".nrrd"):
137                self._load_nrrd_image_file(self.pth_image)
138            elif str(pth_phantom_file).endswith(".nii.gz"):
139                self._load_nifti_image_file(self.pth_image)
140        elif pth_egsphant_file is not None:
141            self.egsphant_obj = BrachyEgsphant(pth_egsphant_file=pth_egsphant_file)
142        elif image_obj is not None:
143            self.image_obj = image_obj
144        else:
145            warnings.warn("No geometry source file provided. Creating an empty Phantom", stacklevel=2)
146
147        if pth_structures_file is not None:
148            pth_structures_file = Path(pth_structures_file)
149            assert os.path.exists(pth_structures_file), "The input path does not exist."
150            self._load_structure_file(pth_structures_file)
151        elif structure_set is not None:
152            if isinstance(structure_set, RTStruct):
153                self.structure_set = structure_set
154            else:
155                self.set_structure_set(structure_set)
156
157        if pth_egsphant_file is not None:
158            self.egsphant_obj = BrachyEgsphant(pth_egsphant_file=pth_egsphant_file)

Purpose:

  • Initialize the BrachyPhantom class based on the input path. The input path can be either the directory of the DICOM files or the path of the phantom file (in .nrrd). The structures file is optional. It is also possible to load the structures only without a phantom file. in that case, an empty image_obj is created with the dimensions matching the structures file.

    Inputs:

  • dir_dicom: Path := the directory of the DICOM files.

  • pth_phantom_file: Path := the path of the phantom .nrrd file.
  • pth_structures_file: Path := the path of the structure file.

  • pth_egsphant_file: Path := the path of the Egsphant file to be loaded. note that it is possible to generate an Egsphant from BrachyPhantom object.

    Outputs:

  • None

    Dependencies:

  • openTPS.core

  • BrachyEgsphant

image_modality: Literal['CT', 'MR', 'US']
structure_set
structure_names: List[str]

def get_structure_mask( self, query_structure_list: List[str], mask_type: Union[numpy.ndarray, opentps.core.data._roiContour.ROIContour, opentps.core.data.images._roiMask.ROIMask, str] = <class 'opentps.core.data.images._roiMask.ROIMask'>, strict_name_match: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Union[opentps.core.data.images._roiMask.ROIMask, numpy.ndarray, opentps.core.data._roiContour.ROIContour]]: 
367    def get_structure_mask(
368        self,
369        query_structure_list: List[str],
370        mask_type: Union[np.ndarray, ROIContour, ROIMask, str] = ROIMask,
371        strict_name_match: bool = True,
372    ) -> Dict[str, Union[np.ndarray, ROIContour, ROIMask]]:
373        r"""
374        ### Purpose:
375        - To return a dictionary with the requested structure masks from BrachyPhantom object. The queried
376        structure string should be a subset of the structure string in the dicom file. For example,
377        if the structure string in dicom file is CTV_BRACHY, then the query string can be CTV or ctv.
378        The keys in the dictionary match the query_structure_list and the values are the masks.
379        ### Inputs:
380        - query_structure_list := list of structure names to find the mask of.
381        - mask_type: Union[np.ndarray, ROIContour, ROIMask] := the type of the mask to return.
382            if np.ndarray (or str "array"), the mask will be returned as a numpy array in [z, y, x] format.
383            if ROIContour (or str "contour"), the mask will be returned as a ROIContour object in [x, y, z] format.
384            if ROIMask (or str "mask"), the mask will be returned as a ROIMask object in [x, y, z] format.
385        ### Outputs:
386        - mask_dict:dict :=  a dictionary with the queried structure name as key and the mask as value.
387        """
388        assert (
389            self.structure_set is not None
390        ), "structure masks have not been loaded yet. please run load_structure_file() first"
391        mask_dict: dict = {}
392        flattened_query_structure_list = []
393      
394        for query_structure in query_structure_list:
395            if isinstance(query_structure, list):
396                flattened_query_structure_list.extend(query_structure)
397            else:
398                flattened_query_structure_list.append(query_structure)
399
400        for query_structure in flattened_query_structure_list:
401            for mask_name in self.structure_names:
402                if strict_name_match:
403                    pick_structure = query_structure.lower() == mask_name.lower()
404                else:
405                    pick_structure = query_structure.lower() in mask_name.lower()
406                if pick_structure:
407                    mask = self.structure_set.getContourByName(mask_name).getBinaryMask(
408                        origin=self.image_obj.origin,
409                        gridSize=self.image_obj.gridSize,
410                        spacing=self.image_obj.spacing,
411                    )
412                    if not np.any(mask.imageArray):
413                        warnings.warn(
414                            f"mask for {query_structure} is all zeros",
415                            stacklevel=2
416                        )
417                        mask.imageArray = np.zeros(self.image_obj.gridSize)
418                        mask.origin = self.image_obj.origin
419                        mask.spacing = self.image_obj.spacing
420                        mask.gridSize = self.image_obj.gridSize
421                    if mask_type == np.ndarray or mask_type == "array":
422                        mask_dict[query_structure] = np.swapaxes(
423                            mask.imageArray, 0, 2
424                        )
425                    elif mask_type == ROIContour or mask_type == "contour":
426                        mask_dict[query_structure] = (
427                            self.structure_set.getContourByName(mask_name)
428                        )
429                    elif mask_type == ROIMask or mask_type == "mask":
430                        mask_dict[query_structure] = mask
431                    else:
432                        raise ValueError(f"mask_type {mask_type} not recognized")
433        return mask_dict

Purpose:

  • To return a dictionary with the requested structure masks from BrachyPhantom object. The queried structure string should be a subset of the structure string in the dicom file. For example, if the structure string in dicom file is CTV_BRACHY, then the query string can be CTV or ctv. The keys in the dictionary match the query_structure_list and the values are the masks.

    Inputs:

  • query_structure_list := list of structure names to find the mask of.

  • mask_type: Union[np.ndarray, ROIContour, ROIMask] := the type of the mask to return. if np.ndarray (or str "array"), the mask will be returned as a numpy array in [z, y, x] format. if ROIContour (or str "contour"), the mask will be returned as a ROIContour object in [x, y, z] format. if ROIMask (or str "mask"), the mask will be returned as a ROIMask object in [x, y, z] format.

    Outputs:

  • mask_dict:dict := a dictionary with the queried structure name as key and the mask as value.

def is_equal(self, other: BrachyPhantom) -> bool: 
506    def is_equal(self, other: "BrachyPhantom") -> bool:
507        r"""
508        Purpose:
509            - Check if two BrachyPhantom objects have equal image_obj.
510        Inputs:
511            - other: BrachyPhantom := the other BrachyPhantom object.
512        Outputs:
513            - bool := True if the two objects are equal, False otherwise.
514        """
515        if not isinstance(other, BrachyPhantom):
516            warnings.warn(
517                "The input object is not a BrachyPhantom object.", stacklevel=2
518            )
519            return False
520        elif not self.image_modality == other.image_modality:
521            warnings.warn("The image modalities are not the same.", stacklevel=2)
522            return False
523        elif not self.unit_length == other.unit_length:
524            warnings.warn("The unit lengths are not the same.", stacklevel=2)
525            return False
526        elif not np.array_equal(self.image_obj.imageArray, other.image_obj.imageArray):
527            warnings.warn("The image arrays are not the same.", stacklevel=2)
528            return False
529        elif self.structure_set is not None and other.structure_set is not None:
530            for structure_name in self.structure_names:
531                if self.structure_set.getContourByName(
532                    structure_name
533                ) != other.structure_set.getContourByName(structure_name):
534                    warnings.warn(
535                        f"The structure masks for {structure_name} are not the same.",
536                        stacklevel=2,
537                    )
538                    return False
539        else:
540            return True

Purpose: - Check if two BrachyPhantom objects have equal image_obj. Inputs: - other: BrachyPhantom := the other BrachyPhantom object. Outputs: - bool := True if the two objects are equal, False otherwise.

def write_image_to_nrrd( self, pth_output: pathlib._local.Path | str, metadata: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None) -> None: 
583    def write_image_to_nrrd(
584        self,
585        pth_output: Path | str,
586        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
587        ) -> None:
588        r"""
589        Purpose:
590            - To write the image to a nrrd file. By default, all images are written as Left Posterior Superior.

594                "cancer site":
595                "care center":
596                "number of dwell positions":
597                "number of segmented structures":
598                "patient number":
599                "Image content": "[3D dose, 3D uncertainty]"
600        Outputs:

610        imageToNrrd(

Inputs: - pth_output: Path := the path to write the image to. - metadata := a dictionary containing the following meta data key values (should be changed later): "cancer site": "care center": "number of dwell positions": "number of segmented structures": "patient number": "Image content": "[3D dose, 3D uncertainty]" Outputs: - None Dependencies: - pynrrd

def write_structures_to_nrrd( self, pth_output: pathlib._local.Path | str, overlap: Optional[bool] = True, representation: Literal['contour', 'mask'] = 'mask', metadata: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None) -> None: 
618    def write_structures_to_nrrd(
619        self,
620        pth_output: Path | str,
621        overlap: Optional[bool] = True,
622        representation: Literal["contour", "mask"] = "mask",
623        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
624    ) -> None:
625        r"""
626        Purpose:
627            - To write the structures to a nrrd file. By defualt, we remove the overlap between the structures. the smaller structures
628            overwrite the larger structures if there is an overlap.
629        Inputs:
630            - pth_output: Path := the path to write the structures to.
631            - overlap: Optional[bool] := if True, the structures will be written with overlap, meaning each structure will be represented
632            by a binary matrix with 1s and 0s. if False, the structures will be written without overlap, an integer is asigned to 
633            each structure and all the structures are represented by a single volume.
634            - metadata: Optional[Dict[str, str]] := a dictionary containing any meta data additional to the minimal required meta data.
635        Outputs:
636            - None
637        Dependencies:
638            - pynrrd
639        """
640        if isinstance(pth_output, str):
641            pth_output = Path(pth_output)
642        if representation == "mask":
643            structure_mask_dict: Dict[str, ROIMask] = self.get_structure_mask(
644                self.structure_names, mask_type=ROIMask
645            )
646            masksToNrrd(
647                structure_mask_dict=structure_mask_dict,
648                pth_output=pth_output,
649                overlap=overlap,
650                metadata=metadata,
651            )
652        elif representation == "contour":
653            raise NotImplementedError(
654                "Writing structures to nrrd in contour representation is not implemented yet."
655            )
656        else:
657            raise ValueError(
658                f"Format {representation} not recognized. Please use 'mask' or 'contour'."
659            )

Purpose: - To write the structures to a nrrd file. By defualt, we remove the overlap between the structures. the smaller structures overwrite the larger structures if there is an overlap. Inputs: - pth_output: Path := the path to write the structures to. - overlap: Optional[bool] := if True, the structures will be written with overlap, meaning each structure will be represented by a binary matrix with 1s and 0s. if False, the structures will be written without overlap, an integer is asigned to each structure and all the structures are represented by a single volume. - metadata: Optional[Dict[str, str]] := a dictionary containing any meta data additional to the minimal required meta data. Outputs: - None Dependencies: - pynrrd

def write_to_egsphant( self, pth_output: pathlib._local.Path, material_dict: dict | pathlib._local.Path = None, assign_material_from_ct: bool = None, crop_by_contour: Union[str, List[str]] = None, marginInMM: Union[float, List[float]] = 0.0, resampled_spacing: List[float] = None, resampled_origin: List[float] = None, resample_phantom_base: Optional[bool] = True, background_material: Optional[str] = 'Air', strict_name_match: bool = True) -> None: 
661    def write_to_egsphant(
662        self,
663        pth_output: Path,
664        material_dict: dict | Path = None,
665        assign_material_from_ct: bool = None,
666        crop_by_contour: str | List[str] = None,
667        marginInMM: float | List[float] = 0.0,
668        resampled_spacing: List[float] = None,
669        resampled_origin: List[float] = None,
670        resample_phantom_base: Optional[bool] = True,
671        background_material: Optional[str] = "Air",
672        strict_name_match: bool = True,
673    ) -> None:
674        r"""
675        ### Purpose:
676        - Write the BrachyPhantom object to an Egsphant file.
677        ### Inputs:
678        - pth_output: Path := the path to write the Egsphant file to.
679        - material_dict: dict | Path := the dictionary of the materials. if Path, the path to the material file.
680        The dictionary contains the name of the elements for each voxel,
681        and the following keys: [
682            "density" := the density of the material in g/cm^3,
683            "HU_limit" := the lower HU limit threshold of the material,
684            "structure_name := {optional} the name of the structure in the dicom file that represents the material,"
685        ]
686        - assign_material_from_ct: bool := if True, the material will be assigned from the CT image.
687        - crop_by_contour: str | List[str] := the name of the structure in the dicom file to crop the phantom by.
688        If a list of names is provided, the union of the structures will be used to crop the phantom.
689        - marginInMM: float := the margin in mm to add to the cropped phantom. default is 0.
690        - resampled_spacing: List[float] := the spacing to resample the egsphant to.
691        - background_material: Optional[str] := the name of the background material. default is "Air".
692        """
693        pth_output = Path(pth_output)
694        if not str(pth_output).endswith(".egsphant") and not str(pth_output).endswith(".seq.nrrd"):
695            raise ValueError("The output file should have '.egsphant' or '.seq.nrrd' extension.")
696        #if the egsphant is already made, write it
697        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(pth_output), exist_ok=True)
698        if self.egsphant_obj is not None:
699            if str(pth_output).endswith(".egsphant"):
700                self.egsphant_obj.write_to_ctegsphant(pth_output)
701            elif str(pth_output).endswith(".seq.nrrd"):
702                self.egsphant_obj.write_to_nrrd(pth_output)
703#prepare the phantom for egsphant conversion
704        elif self.image_obj is not None:
705            phantom_used_for_egsphant = deepcopy(self)
706            from brachyutils.geometry.egsphant_utils import BrachyEgsphant
707            
708            if resampled_spacing is not None or resampled_origin is not None: #if we want to resample
709                if resample_phantom_base: #resample the phantom and structures that the egsphant is based on
710                    phantom_used_for_egsphant.resample_to(
711                        origin=resampled_origin,
712                        spacing=resampled_spacing,
713                        inplace=True
714                    )
715
716            self.egsphant_obj = BrachyEgsphant(
717                phantom=phantom_used_for_egsphant,
718                material_dict=material_dict,
719                assign_material_from_ct=assign_material_from_ct,
720                background_material=background_material
721            )
722  
723            if crop_by_contour is not None:
724                self.egsphant_obj.crop_by_contour(
725                    phantom_used_for_egsphant,
726                    crop_by_contour,
727                    strict_name_match=strict_name_match,
728                    marginInMM=marginInMM)
729
730            if resampled_spacing is not None and not resample_phantom_base:
731                self.egsphant_obj.material_image = resampleImage3D(
732                    image=self.egsphant_obj.material_image,
733                    origin=resampled_origin,
734                    spacing=resampled_spacing, 
735                    outputType=np.int16)
736                self.egsphant_obj.density_image = resampleImage3D(
737                    image=self.egsphant_obj.density_image,
738                    origin=resampled_origin,
739                    spacing=resampled_spacing,)
740                    # sitk_interpolator=sitk.sitkNearestNeighbor)
741                self.egsphant_obj.get_voxel_edges()
742            if str(pth_output).endswith(".egsphant"):
743                self.egsphant_obj.write_to_ctegsphant(pth_output)
744            elif str(pth_output).endswith(".seq.nrrd"):
745                self.egsphant_obj.write_to_nrrd(pth_output)
746        else:
747            raise ValueError(
748                "No image object or egsphant object to write to Egsphant file. Please load the image object first."
749            )

Purpose:

  • Write the BrachyPhantom object to an Egsphant file.

    Inputs:

  • pth_output: Path := the path to write the Egsphant file to.

  • material_dict: dict | Path := the dictionary of the materials. if Path, the path to the material file. The dictionary contains the name of the elements for each voxel, and the following keys: [ "density" := the density of the material in g/cm^3, "HU_limit" := the lower HU limit threshold of the material, "structure_name := {optional} the name of the structure in the dicom file that represents the material," ]
  • assign_material_from_ct: bool := if True, the material will be assigned from the CT image.
  • crop_by_contour: str | List[str] := the name of the structure in the dicom file to crop the phantom by. If a list of names is provided, the union of the structures will be used to crop the phantom.
  • marginInMM: float := the margin in mm to add to the cropped phantom. default is 0.
  • resampled_spacing: List[float] := the spacing to resample the egsphant to.
  • background_material: Optional[str] := the name of the background material. default is "Air".
def export_to( self, pth_image_out: pathlib._local.Path | str = None, pth_structures_out: pathlib._local.Path | str = None, dir_dicom_out: pathlib._local.Path | str = None, dir_nrrd_out: pathlib._local.Path | str = None): 
751    def export_to(
752        self,
753        pth_image_out: Path | str = None,
754        pth_structures_out: Path | str = None,
755        dir_dicom_out: Path | str = None,
756        dir_nrrd_out: Path | str = None
757        ):
758        r"""
759        Purpose:
760            - To export the image and/or the structures to file. This function will call the appropriate
761            export function depending on the extension of the given path. If you would like to export
762            to egsphant, please use write_to_egsphant() function.
763        Inputs:
764            pth_image_out:= path to the output image file. If the extension could be .nrrd. To export images
765            to dicom, use dir_dicom_out.
766            pth_structures_out:= path to the output structure file, the extension could be .nrrd or .dcm
767            dir_dicom_out:= path to export all the dicom informatin to. it has to be a directory
768        """
769        if pth_image_out is not None:
770            pth_image_out = Path(pth_image_out)
771            assert self.image_obj is not None, "no image is loaded into this BrachyPhantom"
772            if str(pth_image_out).endswith(".nrrd"):
773                self.write_image_to_nrrd(pth_output=pth_image_out)
774
775        if pth_structures_out is not None:
776            pth_structures_out = Path(pth_structures_out)
777            assert self.structure_set is not None, "no structures is loaded into this BrachyPhantom"
778            self.write_structures_to_nrrd(pth_output=pth_structures_out)
779
780        if dir_dicom_out is not None:
781            dir_dicom_out = Path(dir_dicom_out)
782            os.makedirs(dir_dicom_out, exist_ok=True)
783            assert dir_dicom_out.is_dir(), f"the provided path {dir_dicom_out} is not a directory"
784            if self.image_obj is not None:
785                self.write_image_to_dicom(dir_output=dir_dicom_out)
786            if self.structure_set is not None:
787                self.write_structures_to_dicom(dir_output=dir_dicom_out)
788
789        if dir_nrrd_out is not None:
790            dir_nrrd_out = Path(dir_nrrd_out)
791            os.makedirs(dir_nrrd_out, exist_ok=True)
792            assert dir_nrrd_out.is_dir(), f"the provided path {dir_nrrd_out} is not a directory"
793            if self.image_obj is not None:
794                self.write_image_to_nrrd(
795                    pth_output=Path.joinpath(dir_nrrd_out, str(self.pth_image.name).split(".")[0]+".nrrd")
796                    )
797            if self.structure_set is not None and len(self.structure_set.contours) > 0:
798                self.write_structures_to_nrrd(
799                    pth_output=Path.joinpath(dir_nrrd_out, str(self.pth_image.name).split(".")[0]+".seg.nrrd")
800                )

If you would like to export to egsphant, please use write_to_egsphant() function. Inputs: pth_image_out:= path to the output image file. If the extension could be .nrrd. To export images to dicom, use dir_dicom_out. pth_structures_out:= path to the output structure file, the extension could be .nrrd or .dcm dir_dicom_out:= path to export all the dicom informatin to. it has to be a directory

def crop_by_coordinates( self, coordinate_range: Union[List[float], <built-in function array>], inplace: BrachyPhantom = True, marginInMM: Union[float, List[float]] = 0.0) -> None: 
802    def crop_by_coordinates(
803        self,
804        coordinate_range: List[float] | np.array,
805        inplace: "BrachyPhantom" = True,
806        marginInMM: float | List[float] = 0.0,
807    ) -> None:
808        r"""
809        Purpose:
810            - Crop the phantom by the input coordinates.
811        Inputs:
812            - coordinate_range := a 3 x 2 array holding the min and max on x, y and z axis
813                [[ix_min, ix_max], [iy_min, iy_max], [iz_min, iz_max]]
814            - inplace := if True, the cropping will be done in place. if False, a new BrachyPhantom object will be returned.
815        Outputs:
816            - None
817        """
818        import copy
819
820        from opentps.core.processing.imageProcessing.resampler3D import (
821            crop3DDataAroundBox,
822        )
823
824        coordinate_range = np.array(coordinate_range)
825        assert coordinate_range.shape == (
826            3,
827            2,
828        ), "coordinate_range should be a 3x2 array in x, y, z order"
829        if isinstance(marginInMM, float):
830            marginInMM = [marginInMM]*3
831        if inplace:
832            crop3DDataAroundBox(self.image_obj, coordinate_range, marginInMM=marginInMM)
833        else:
834            new_phantom: BrachyPhantom = copy.deepcopy(self)
835            new_phantom.crop_by_coordinates(coordinate_range, inplace=True, marginInMM=marginInMM)
836            return new_phantom

Purpose: - Crop the phantom by the input coordinates. Inputs: - coordinate_range := a 3 x 2 array holding the min and max on x, y and z axis [[ix_min, ix_max], [iy_min, iy_max], [iz_min, iz_max]] - inplace := if True, the cropping will be done in place. if False, a new BrachyPhantom object will be returned. Outputs: - None

def crop_by_index( self, index_range: Union[List[int], <built-in function array>], inplace: Optional[bool] = True, marginInMM: Union[float, List[float]] = 0.0) -> Optional[BrachyPhantom]: 
838    def crop_by_index(
839        self,
840        index_range: List[int] | np.array,
841        inplace: Optional[bool] = True,
842        marginInMM: float | List[float] = 0.0,
843    ) -> Union[None, "BrachyPhantom"]:
844        r"""
845        Purpose:
846            - given a range of indicies (mix and max on each axis), this function will crop
847            image_obj and will adjust the rest of the attributes accordingly.
848        Inputs:
849            - self: BrachyEgsphant object
850            - index_range := a 3 x 2 array holding the min and max index on x, y and z axis
851                [[ix_min, ix_max], [iy_min, iy_max], [iz_min, iz_max]]
852            - inplace := if True, the cropping will be done in place. if False, a new BrachyPhantom object will be returned.
853        Outputs:
854            - None
855        """
856        assert index_range.shape == (
857            3,
858            2,
859        ), "index_range should be a 3x2 array in x, y, z order"
860        new_origin_coords = self.image_obj.getPositionFromVoxelIndex(
861            index_range[:, 0]
862        )
863        new_ending_coords = self.image_obj.getPositionFromVoxelIndex(
864            index_range[:, 1]
865        )
866        new_coords_range = np.column_stack([new_origin_coords, new_ending_coords])
867        return self.crop_by_coordinates(new_coords_range, inplace, marginInMM=marginInMM)

Purpose: - given a range of indicies (mix and max on each axis), this function will crop image_obj and will adjust the rest of the attributes accordingly. Inputs: - self: BrachyEgsphant object - index_range := a 3 x 2 array holding the min and max index on x, y and z axis [[ix_min, ix_max], [iy_min, iy_max], [iz_min, iz_max]] - inplace := if True, the cropping will be done in place. if False, a new BrachyPhantom object will be returned. Outputs: - None

def crop_by_contour( self, contour_name: Union[str, List[str]], inplace: bool = True, strict_name_match: bool = True, marginInMM: Union[float, List[float]] = 0.0) -> Optional[BrachyPhantom]: 
869    def crop_by_contour(
870        self,
871        contour_name: str | List[str],
872        inplace: bool = True,
873        strict_name_match: bool = True,
874        marginInMM: float | List[float] = 0.0,
875    ) -> Union[None, "BrachyPhantom"]:
876        r"""
877        Purpose:
878            - Crop the phantom by the input contours.
879        Inputs:
880            - contour_name: str := the name of the contour to crop by.
881            - inplace: Optional[None | "BrachyPhantom"] := if True, the cropping will be done in place. if False, a new BrachyPhantom object will be returned.
882        Outputs:
883            - None
884        """
885        from opentps.core.processing.imageProcessing.resampler3D import (
886            resampleImage3DOnImage3D,
887        )
888        from opentps.core.processing.segmentation.segmentation3D import getBoxAroundROI
889        if isinstance(contour_name, str):
890            contour_name = [contour_name]
891        if isinstance(marginInMM, float):
892            marginInMM = [marginInMM, marginInMM, marginInMM]
893        mask_dict = self.get_structure_mask(
894            contour_name,
895            mask_type=ROIMask,
896            strict_name_match=strict_name_match)
897        combined_mask_array = np.zeros_like(
898            mask_dict[contour_name[0]].imageArray, dtype=bool
899        )
900        for name in contour_name:
901            combined_mask_array = np.logical_or(combined_mask_array, mask_dict[name].imageArray)
902        combined_mask = ROIMask(
903            imageArray=combined_mask_array,
904            origin=self.image_obj.origin,
905            spacing=self.image_obj.spacing,
906        )
907        resampled_mask = resampleImage3DOnImage3D(
908            combined_mask, self.image_obj
909        )
910        box_around_mask = np.array(getBoxAroundROI(resampled_mask))
911        return self.crop_by_coordinates(box_around_mask, inplace, marginInMM)

Purpose: - Crop the phantom by the input contours. Inputs: - contour_name: str := the name of the contour to crop by. - inplace: Optional[None | "BrachyPhantom"] := if True, the cropping will be done in place. if False, a new BrachyPhantom object will be returned. Outputs: - None

def cache_structure_set_as_masks( self, interpolator_contours=1, pth_structures_file: str | pathlib._local.Path = None, mask_colors: Union[Dict[str, Sequence[int]], Sequence[int]] = None) -> None: 
913    def cache_structure_set_as_masks(
914        self,
915        interpolator_contours=sitk.sitkNearestNeighbor,
916        pth_structures_file: str | Path = None,
917        mask_colors: Dict[str, Sequence[int]] | Sequence[int] = None,
918    ) -> None:
919        r"""
920        Purpose:
921            - Cache the structure set as masks. This will resample the masks to the image object.
922            Function used in case you query multiple time the masks from the BrachyPhantom object
923            and you want to avoid resampling the masks each time.
924        Inputs:
925            - interpolator_contours: sitk.InterpolatorEnum := the interpolator to use for resampling the contours.
926        Outputs:
927            - None
928        """
929        from opentps.core.processing.imageProcessing.resampler3D import resampleImage3DOnImage3D
930
931        if pth_structures_file is not None:
932            assert pth_structures_file.endswith(".nrrd"), "the structure file should be a nrrd file"
933            structure_dict, _ = readNrrdStruct(pth_structures_file)
934        else:
935            structure_dict = self.get_structure_mask(
936                self.structure_names,
937                mask_type=ROIMask,
938                )
939        slicer_colors = _get_slicer_colors()
940        # set the default color dictionary if not provided
941        if mask_colors is None:
942            mask_colors = {
943                k: slicer_colors[i+1]["color"] for i, k in enumerate(structure_dict.keys())
944            }
945        elif isinstance(mask_colors, Sequence):
946            mask_colors = {
947                k: mask_colors for k in structure_dict.keys()
948            }
949
950        new_structure_dict = {}
951        for struc in structure_dict.keys():
952            mask = structure_dict[struc]
953            old_color = mask._displayColor
954            structure_color = mask_colors.get(struc)
955            if not(old_color is None):
956                new_color = old_color
957            else:
958                new_color = structure_color
959            if not np.array_equal(mask.spacing, self.image_obj.spacing) or \
960                not np.array_equal(mask.origin, self.image_obj.origin) or \
961                not np.array_equal(mask.gridSize, self.image_obj.gridSize):
962                new_structure_dict[struc] = resampleImage3DOnImage3D(
963                    mask,
964                    self.image_obj,
965                    sitk_interpolator=interpolator_contours
966                    )
967            else:
968                new_structure_dict[struc] = mask
969            new_structure_dict[struc]._displayColor = new_color
970        # Store the resampled masks in the cached_structure_masks attribute
971        self.cached_structure_masks = new_structure_dict

Purpose: - Cache the structure set as masks. This will resample the masks to the image object. Function used in case you query multiple time the masks from the BrachyPhantom object and you want to avoid resampling the masks each time. Inputs: - interpolator_contours: sitk.InterpolatorEnum := the interpolator to use for resampling the contours. Outputs: - None

def set_structure_set( self, mask_dict: Dict[str, Union[opentps.core.data.images._roiMask.ROIMask, opentps.core.data._roiContour.ROIContour, numpy.ndarray, SimpleITK.SimpleITK.Image]], mask_colors: Union[Dict[str, Tuple[int, int, int]], Tuple[int, int, int]] = None) -> None: 
 973    def set_structure_set(
 974        self,
 975        mask_dict: Dict[str, Union[ROIMask, ROIContour, np.ndarray, sitk.Image]],
 976        mask_colors: Dict[str, Tuple[int, int, int]] | Tuple[int, int, int] = None,
 977        ) -> None:
 978        r"""
 979        ### Purpose:
 980        - Set the structure set with the input mask dictionary mapping structure names to ROIMask.
 981        If the name of a structure is in the structure set, the mask will be replaced.
 982        If the name of a structure is not in the structure set, a new structure will be added.
 983        The mask will be resampled to the image object if it exists.
 984        ### Inputs:
 985        - mask_dict: dict := the dictionary of the masks.
 986        - mask_colors: dict | tuple := the dictionary of the colors for each structure. If a tuple is provided,
 987        the same color will be used for all structures. If None is provided, the default colors will be used based
 988        on the slicer color table https://www.slicer.org/wiki/Slicer3:2010_GenericAnatomyColors.
 989        The values could be numpy arrays, ROIContour or ROIMask objects.
 990        ### Outputs:
 991        - None
 992        """
 993        from opentps.core.processing.imageProcessing.resampler3D import (
 994            resampleImage3DOnImage3D,
 995        )
 996        from opentps.core.processing.segmentation.segmentation3D import getBoxAroundROI
 997        slicer_colors = _get_slicer_colors()
 998        # set the default color dictionary if not provided
 999        if mask_colors is None:
1000            mask_colors = {
1001                k: slicer_colors[i+1]["color"] for i, k in enumerate(mask_dict.keys())
1002            }
1003        elif isinstance(mask_colors, Sequence):
1004            mask_colors = {
1005                k: mask_colors for k in mask_dict.keys()
1006            }
1007
1008        for structure_name in mask_dict:
1009            structure_color = mask_colors.get(structure_name)
1010            # check if the structure already exists in structure set
1011            old_structure = self.structure_set.getContourByName(structure_name)
1012            if old_structure is None:
1013                old_structure = self.structure_set.getContourByName(structure_name.upper())
1014            if old_structure is not None:
1015                self.structure_set.removeContour(old_structure)
1016                structure_color = old_structure.color
1017
1018            #print(f"setting structure {structure_name}, which is a {type(mask_dict[structure_name])} type")
1019            if mask_dict.get(structure_name) is None:
1020                continue
1021            if isinstance(mask_dict.get(structure_name), np.ndarray):
1022                mask = ROIMask(
1023                    name=structure_name,
1024                    imageArray=np.swapaxes(mask_dict[structure_name], 0, 2),
1025                    origin=self.image_obj.origin,
1026                    spacing=self.image_obj.spacing,
1027                )
1028            elif isinstance(mask_dict.get(structure_name), ROIContour):
1029                mask = mask_dict.get(structure_name).getBinaryMask(
1030                    origin=self.image_obj.origin,
1031                    spacing=self.image_obj.spacing,
1032                    gridSize=self.image_obj.gridSize,
1033                )
1034                mask.name = structure_name
1035
1036            elif isinstance(mask_dict.get(structure_name), ROIMask):
1037                mask = mask_dict.get(structure_name)
1038                mask.name = structure_name
1039                if self.image_obj is not None:
1040                    # Check if the spacings, the shape and origin already match or not
1041                    if not np.array_equal(mask.spacing, self.image_obj.spacing) or \
1042                        not np.array_equal(mask.origin, self.image_obj.origin) or \
1043                        not np.array_equal(mask.gridSize, self.image_obj.gridSize):
1044                        # Resample the mask to the image object
1045                        mask = resampleImage3DOnImage3D(mask, self.image_obj)   
1046            elif isinstance(mask_dict.get(structure_name), sitk.Image):
1047                mask = ROIMask(
1048                    name=structure_name,
1049                    imageArray=sitk.GetArrayFromImage(mask_dict[structure_name]),
1050                    origin=mask_dict[structure_name].GetOrigin(),
1051                    spacing=mask_dict[structure_name].GetSpacing(),
1052                )
1053            else:
1054                raise ValueError("The mask type is not recognized.")
1055 
1056            # if mask hits the boundary of the image, set the boundary to 0.
1057            tight_box_coordinates = np.round(getBoxAroundROI(mask), decimals=2)
1058            mask_edges = np.array(
1059                [
1060                    mask.getPositionFromVoxelIndex([0, 0, 0]),
1061                    mask.getPositionFromVoxelIndex(mask.gridSize-1)
1062                    ]
1063                )
1064            mask_edges = np.round(mask_edges, decimals=2)
1065            mask_edges = np.reshape(mask_edges.T, (3, 2))
1066            touching_edge = (tight_box_coordinates == mask_edges).flatten()
1067            for i, edge in enumerate(touching_edge):
1068                if edge:
1069                    if i == 0:
1070                        mask.imageArray[0, :, :] = 0
1071                    elif i == 1:
1072                        mask.imageArray[-1, :, :] = 0
1073                    elif i == 2:
1074                        mask.imageArray[:, 0, :] = 0
1075                    elif i == 3:
1076                        mask.imageArray[:, -1, :] = 0
1077                    # hitting the ends of the z axis is not problematic
1078                    # elif i == 4:
1079                    #     mask.imageArray[:, :, 0] = 0
1080                    # elif i == 5:
1081                        # mask.imageArray[:, :, -1] = 0
1082
1083            mask._displayColor = structure_color
1084            self.structure_set.appendContour(mask.getROIContour())
1085            del mask
1086
1087        self.structure_set.setPatient(
1088                self.image_obj.patient if self.image_obj is not None else None
1089            )
1090
1091        # self.structure_set.seriesInstanceUID = self.image_obj.seriesInstanceUID if self.structure_set is not None else ""
1092        # self.structure_set.sopInstanceUID = self.image_obj.sopInstanceUID if self.structure_set is None else ""
1093        self._update_structure_names()

Purpose:

  • Set the structure set with the input mask dictionary mapping structure names to ROIMask. If the name of a structure is in the structure set, the mask will be replaced. If the name of a structure is not in the structure set, a new structure will be added. The mask will be resampled to the image object if it exists.

    Inputs:

  • mask_dict: dict := the dictionary of the masks.

  • mask_colors: dict | tuple := the dictionary of the colors for each structure. If a tuple is provided, the same color will be used for all structures. If None is provided, the default colors will be used based on the slicer color table https://www.slicer.org/wiki/Slicer3:2010_GenericAnatomyColors. The values could be numpy arrays, ROIContour or ROIMask objects.

    Outputs:

  • None

def rename_structures(self, structure_name_dict: dict) -> None: 
1106    def rename_structures(self, structure_name_dict: dict) -> None:
1107        r"""
1108        Purpose:
1109            - First purpose is to rename the structures in the structure set.
1110            - Additional purpose is to remove structures if their new name is 'REMOVE'.
1111        
1112        Inputs:
1113            - structure_name_dict: dict := the dictionary of the structure names to rename.
1114            The keys are the old names and the values are the new names.
1115        
1116        Outputs:
1117            - None
1118        """
1119        assert len(self.structure_set) > 0 or len(self.cached_structure_masks) > 0, (
1120            "No structures to rename. Please load the structures first."
1121        )
1122        if len(self.cached_structure_masks) > 0:
1123            new_cached_structure_masks = {}
1124            for old_name, new_name in structure_name_dict.items():
1125                if old_name in self.cached_structure_masks:
1126                    if new_name == "REMOVE":
1127                        continue
1128                    new_cached_structure_masks[new_name] = self.cached_structure_masks[old_name]
1129                else:
1130                    warnings.warn(f"The structure {old_name} does not exist in the cached masks.")
1131            self.cached_structure_masks = new_cached_structure_masks
1132            
1133        if len(self.structure_set) > 0:
1134            for old_name, new_name in structure_name_dict.items():
1135                if new_name == "REMOVE":
1136                    self.remove_structure(old_name)
1137                    continue
1138                structure = self.structure_set.getContourByName(old_name)
1139                if structure is not None:
1140                    structure.name = new_name
1141                else:
1142                    warnings.warn(f"The structure {old_name} does not exist.")
1143            self._update_structure_names()

Purpose: - First purpose is to rename the structures in the structure set. - Additional purpose is to remove structures if their new name is 'REMOVE'.

Inputs: - structure_name_dict: dict := the dictionary of the structure names to rename. The keys are the old names and the values are the new names.

Outputs: - None

def remove_structure(self, structure_name: str) -> None: 
1145    def remove_structure(self, structure_name: str) -> None:
1146        r"""
1147        Purpose:
1148            - Remove the structure from the structure set.
1149        Inputs:
1150            - structure_name: str := the name of the structure to remove.
1151        Outputs:
1152            - None
1153        """
1154        structure = self.structure_set.getContourByName(structure_name)
1155        if structure is not None:
1156            self.structure_set.removeContour(structure)
1157            self._update_structure_names()
1158        else:
1159            warnings.warn(f"The structure {structure_name} does not exist.")

Purpose: - Remove the structure from the structure set. Inputs: - structure_name: str := the name of the structure to remove. Outputs: - None

def resample_to( self, origin: <built-in function array> = None, spacing: <built-in function array> = None, inplace: bool = True, gridSize: <built-in function array> = None, interpolator_img=2, interpolator_contours=2) -> BrachyPhantom: 
1161    def resample_to(
1162        self,
1163        origin:np.array=None,
1164        spacing:np.array=None,
1165        inplace:bool=True,
1166        gridSize:np.array=None,
1167        interpolator_img=sitk.sitkLinear, 
1168        interpolator_contours=sitk.sitkLinear) -> "BrachyPhantom":
1169        r"""
1170        ### Purpose:
1171            - resample the phantom to a new origin and spacing.
1172        
1173        ### Inputs:
1174            - origin:np.array := the new origin of the image.
1175            - spacing:np.array := the new spacing of the image.
1176            - inplace:bool := if True, the resampling will be done in place.
1177        
1178        ### Outputs:
1179            - BrachyPhantom := the resampled phantom object if the inplace is False
1180        """
1181        from opentps.core.processing.imageProcessing.resampler3D import resampleImage3D
1182        new_phantom = phantom_with_empty_image_like(self, new_pth_image=self.pth_image)
1183        new_img_obj = resampleImage3D(
1184            self.image_obj,
1185            origin=origin,
1186            spacing=spacing,
1187            gridSize=gridSize,
1188            sitk_interpolator=interpolator_img
1189            )
1190        
1191        if self.cached_structure_masks is not None and len(self.cached_structure_masks) > 0:
1192            new_cached_structure_masks = {}
1193            for structure_name, mask in self.cached_structure_masks.items():
1194                old_color = mask._displayColor
1195                new_cached_structure_masks[structure_name] = resampleImage3DOnImage3D(
1196                    mask,
1197                    new_img_obj,
1198                    sitk_interpolator=interpolator_contours
1199                    )
1200                new_cached_structure_masks[structure_name]._displayColor = old_color
1201            self.cached_structure_masks = new_cached_structure_masks
1202
1203        if inplace:
1204            self.image_obj = new_img_obj
1205        else:
1206            new_phantom.image_obj = new_img_obj
1207            return new_phantom

Purpose:

- resample the phantom to a new origin and spacing.

Inputs:

- origin:np.array := the new origin of the image.
- spacing:np.array := the new spacing of the image.
- inplace:bool := if True, the resampling will be done in place.

Outputs:

- BrachyPhantom := the resampled phantom object if the inplace is False
def sort_structures_by_name(self, sorted_names): 
1209    def sort_structures_by_name(self, sorted_names):
1210        r"""
1211        Purpose:

1213        Inputs:

1215        Outputs:
1216            - None
1217        """
1218        self.structure_set._contours = sorted(
1219            self.structure_set._contours,

def get_structures_volume(self, structure_names: List[str]) -> Dict[str, float]: 
1226    def get_structures_volume(self, structure_names:List[str]) -> Dict[str, float]:
1227        r"""
1228        Purpose:
1229            - Get the volume of each structure that is requested.
1230        Inputs:
1231            - structure_names: list := the list of names of the structures to get the volumes for.
1232        Outputs:
1233            - volume_dict: dict := the dictionary of the volumes of each structure in cm^3.
1234        """
1235        assert self.image_obj is not None, "No image object to get the volume from."
1236        assert self.structure_set is not None, "No structure set to get the volume from."
1237        mask_dict = self.get_structure_mask(structure_names, mask_type=ROIMask)
1238        volume_dict = {}
1239        for name, mask in mask_dict.items():
1240            assert mask is not None, f"No mask found for structure {name}."
1241            volume_dict[name] = mask.getVolume()/1000 # convert to cm^3
1242        return volume_dict
