129    @computed_field
130    def non_zero_dwell_positions(
131        self,
132        ) -> Dict[str, List[List[float]]]:
133        r"""
134        ### Purpose:
135        - To get the non zero dwell positions in the catheter table.
136        
137        ### Inputs:
138        - catheter_table:CatheterTable := the catheter table object.
139        
140        ### Outputs:
141        - Dict[str, List[List[float]]] := the dictionary mapping each catheter to the list of 
142        dwell positions that were actually used for plan delivery.
143        """
144        non_zero_dwell_positions = {}
145        for catheter in self.catheters_list:
146            dwell_positions = []
147            for dwell in catheter.dwells:
148                if dwell.time > 0.0:
149                    dwell_positions.append(dwell.position)
150            non_zero_dwell_positions[f"Needle_{catheter.index}"] = dwell_positions
151        return non_zero_dwell_positions
152
153    @computed_field
154    def combined_dose(self) -> 'BrachyDose':
155        """
156        ### Purpose:
157        - To calculate the combined dose by multiplying the dose rates with the dwell times.
158        if this value has already been cached without change to the catheter table, then
159        the cache will be returned.
160        We require strict name matching between the _time_diffs and dwell.name_id
161        ### Inputs:
162        - self._cached_combined_dose: The combined dose caclualted previously, which will 
163        be returned if no change to the catheter table has been made.
164        - self._time_diffs: a dictionary of time differences for each dwell in the plan. 
165        This is used to update the combined dose if the dwell times are updated without
166        having to reload the dose rate maps. The keys of the dictionary should be in
167        the format "{catheter.index+1}{dwell.index+1}{dwell.angle" and the values
168        should be the time differences in seconds. If None, the combined dose will
169        be calculated using the current dwell times in the plan.
170        ### Outputs:
171        - self._cached_combined_dose
172        also resets self._time_diffs to None for future.
173        """
174        from brachyutils.dose.dose_utils import BrachyDose
175        all_dwells: List[DwellPosition] = self.all_dwells
176        dwells_with_doserate = [dwell for dwell in all_dwells if dwell.dose_rate is not None]
177        
178        if not dwells_with_doserate:
179            return self._cached_combined_dose
180            # raise ValueError("No dose rate found in this catheter table")
181
182        # Initialize combined dose if not cached
183        if self._cached_combined_dose is None:
184            self._cached_combined_dose = BrachyDose.dose_with_empty_grid_like(
185            dwells_with_doserate[0].dose_rate
186            )
187
188        # Calculate combined dose with or without time diffs
189        for dwell in dwells_with_doserate:
190            dwell_time = (
191            self._time_diffs.get(dwell.name_id, 0) 
192            if self._time_diffs is not None 
193            else dwell.time
194            )
195            if dwell_time != 0:
196                self._cached_combined_dose.dose_image.imageArray += (
197                    dwell.dose_rate.dose_image.imageArray * dwell_time)
198        # reset the time diffs for future
199        self._time_diffs = None
200        return self._cached_combined_dose
201
202    @model_validator(mode="after")
203    def validate_catheter_table(self):
204        r"""
205        ### Purpose:
206        - To initialize the CatheterTable object.
207        
208        ### Inputs:
209        - catheters_dict: List[Catheter] | List[dict] | str | Path | CatheterSetUp | CreatedSetUp :=
210        the list of catheter objects in the catheter table or the path to a json or dicom file.
211        - step_size: float := the step size in mm between the dwell positions on the catheter table.
212        - from_delivered_dwellpositions: bool := if true, the dwell positions inside the delivered dwell positions will be used.
213        ### Outputs:
214        - CatheterTable := the catheter table object.
215        """
216        if (isinstance(self.catheters_dict, str) or
217            isinstance(self.catheters_dict, Path)
218            ):
219            catheter_file = Path(self.catheters_dict)
220
221            if not catheter_file.exists():
222                raise ValueError(f"catheter file {catheter_file} does not exist.")
223            if str(catheter_file).endswith(".mrk.json"):
224                # if the file is a slicer markup file, load it as a json file
225                raise NotImplementedError("this feature is not implemented yet.")
226
227            if str(catheter_file).endswith(".json"):
228                cat_dict = load_from_json(catheter_file)
229            elif str(catheter_file).endswith(".dcm"):
230                cat_dict = load_from_dicom(
231                    pth_dicom=catheter_file,
232                    from_delivered_dwellpositions=self.from_delivered_dwellpositions,
233                )
234            self.catheters_dict = cat_dict["catheter_list"]
235            self.step_size = cat_dict["step_size"]
236
237        elif isinstance(self.catheters_dict, CatheterSetUp):
238            # if the catheters_dict is a CatheterSetUp object, convert it to a CatheterTable
239            cat_setup = self.catheters_dict
240            updated_catheter_dict = _update_catheter_table(
241                catheter_table = cat_setup.catheter_table,
242                digitization_points=cat_setup.digitization_points,
243                fit_function=cat_setup.piece_wise_lines,
244                tips=cat_setup.get_tips_coords(),
245                step_size=cat_setup.step_size,
246            )
247            self.catheters_dict = updated_catheter_dict["catheter_list"]
248            self.step_size = updated_catheter_dict["step_size"]
249
250        elif isinstance(self.catheters_dict, CreatedSetUp):
251            created_setup = self.catheters_dict
252            updated_catheter_dict = created_setup.to_brachyutils_CatheterTable_format()
253            self.catheters_dict = updated_catheter_dict["catheter_list"]
254            self.step_size = updated_catheter_dict["step_size"]
255            self.non_zero_dwell_positions = created_setup.get_non_zero_dwell_positions()
256
257        if isinstance(self.catheters_dict, list):
258            # if catheter dict is a list, convert it to a dict
259            real_dict = defaultdict(Catheter)
260            for cat in self.catheters_dict:
261                cat_obj = Catheter(**cat) if isinstance(cat, dict) else cat
262                real_dict[cat_obj.name_id] = cat_obj
263            self.catheters_dict = real_dict
264
265        # check if the values are dicts or catheter\
266        # self.catheters_dict = {
267        #     key: Catheter(val) if isinstance(val, dict) else val
268        #     for key, val in self.catheters_dict.items()
269        # }
270
271        return self
272
273    def __iter__(self):
274        for catheter in self.catheters_list:
275            yield catheter
276
277    def __len__(self):
278        return len(self.catheters_dict)

280    def __getitem__(self, indices: int | slice | str) ->  Union[Catheter, "CatheterTable"] :
281        r"""
282        ### Purpose:
283        - To get a subset of the catheter table.
284
285        ### Inputs:
286        - self := the CatheterTable object.
287        - indices: int | slice | str := the index, slice or key string to get the 
288        catheters by. index and slice finds the catheters by their catheter.index,
289        while if a string is provided, it'll get the catheters by name_id.
290        note that catheter.name_id = str(catheter.index +1) 
291
292        ### Outputs:
293        - List[Catheter] := the list of catheters in the catheter table.
294        """
295        if isinstance(indices, str):
296            catheter_found = self.catheters_dict.get(indices, None)
297            # make sure that the catheter.index and the indicies match
298            if catheter_found is None:
299                return None
300            elif indices != catheter_found.name_id:
301                raise ValueError("The index of the catheter found and the name_id do not match \
302in the catheters_dict. there is a big bug somewhere in catheter table creation")
303            return catheter_found
304
305        if isinstance(indices, slice):
306            indices = list(range(*indices.indices(len(self.catheters_dict))))
307            name_ids = [str(index+1) for index in indices]
308            caths_found = {name_id: self.catheters_dict.get(name_id, None) for name_id in name_ids}
309            return CatheterTable(
310                catheters_dict=caths_found,
311                step_size=self.step_size,
312                from_delivered_dwellpositions=self.from_delivered_dwellpositions,
313            )
314        elif isinstance(indices, int):
315            if indices < 0 or indices >= len(self.catheters_dict):
316                return None
317            return self.catheters_dict.get(f"{indices+1}", None)
318
319    def __add__(self, other: "CatheterTable") -> "CatheterTable":
320        r"""
321        ### Purpose:
322        - To add two catheter tables together.
323
324        ### Inputs:
325        - self := the first CatheterTable object.
326        - other := the second CatheterTable object.
327
328        ### Outputs:
329        - CatheterTable := the combined CatheterTable object.
330        """
331        if not isinstance(other, CatheterTable):
332            raise ValueError("other should be a CatheterTable object.")
333        if self.step_size != other.step_size:
334            raise ValueError("Cannot add two catheter tables with different stepsizes.")
335        return CatheterTable(
336            catheters_dict=self.catheters_dict | other.catheters_dict,
337            stepsize=self.step_size,
338            from_delivered_dwellpositions=self.from_delivered_dwellpositions,
339        )
340
341    def __iadd__(self, other: "CatheterTable") -> "CatheterTable":
342        r"""
343        ### Purpose:
344        - To add another catheter table to the current catheter table.
345
346        ### Inputs:
347        - self := the current CatheterTable object.
348        - other := the CatheterTable object to be added.
349
350        ### Outputs:
351        - CatheterTable := the updated CatheterTable object.
352        """
353        if not isinstance(other, CatheterTable):
354            raise ValueError("other should be a CatheterTable object.")
355        self.catheters_dict = self.catheters_dict | other.catheters_dict
356        if self.step_size != other.step_size:
357            raise ValueError("Cannot add two catheter tables with different stepsizes.")
358        return self

360    def __delitem__(self, indicies: int | slice | str):
361        r"""
362        ### Purpose:
363        - To delete a few catheters from the catheter table.
364
365        ### Inputs:
366        - self := the CatheterTable object.
367        - indicies: int | slice | str:= the index, slice or the specific name id
368        of the catheter to be deleted.
369
370        ### Outputs:
371        - None
372        """
373        if isinstance(indices, str):
374            del self.catheters_dict[indices]
375        if isinstance(indices, slice):
376            indices = list(range(*slice.indices(len(self.catheters_dict))))
377            name_ids = [str(index+1) for index in indices]
378            for name_id in name_ids:
379                del self.catheters_dict[name_id]
380
381        elif isinstance(indices, int):
382            if indices < 0 or indices >= len(self.catheters_dict):
383                return None
384            del self.catheters_dict[f"{indices+1}"]
385
386    def __sub__(self, other: "CatheterTable") -> "CatheterTable":
387        r"""
388        ### Purpose:
389        - To take the difference between self and other catheter table. If a catheter in the
390        other catheter table does not exist in self (name_id) not found, the entire catheter 
391        will be included in the difference. If the other catheter exists in self, the dwell times,
392        position and rotation of the dwell positions of that catheter are subtracted from
393        the self catheter. If the number of dwells do not match in a catheter, then the entire
394        catheter will be included in the difference.
395        Please note that we dwells with the same indicies are subtracted.
396        This subtraction excludes the dose rates.
397        gen_dose_rate is set to true if the position, rotation or angle has changed.
398
399        ### Inputs:
400        - self := the current CatheterTable object.
401        - other := the CatheterTable object to be subtracted.
402        ### Outputs:
403        - CatheterTable := A catheter table with the differences.
404        """
405        if not isinstance(other, CatheterTable):
406            raise ValueError("other should be a CatheterTable object.")
407        dict_catheter_diffs = defaultdict(Catheter)
408        list_dwell_diffs = []
409        
410        for name_id, other_catheter in other.catheters_dict.items():
411            self_catheter = self[name_id]
412            if self_catheter is None:
413                dict_catheter_diffs[name_id] = other_catheter
414            else:
415                if self_catheter.num_dwell_positions != other_catheter.num_dwell_positions:
416                    # if the number of dwell positions differs, put the entire other catheter
417                    # in the difference!
418                    dict_catheter_diffs[name_id] = other_catheter
419                else:
420                    for other_dwell in other_catheter.dwells:
421                        #  take the diff between the dwells with the same index.
422                        diff_time = self_catheter.dwells[other_dwell.index].time - other_dwell.time
423                        diff_angle = self_catheter.dwells[other_dwell.index].angle - other_dwell.angle
424                        diff_relativePos = (
425                            self_catheter.dwells[other_dwell.index].relativePos
426                            - self_catheter.dwells[other_dwell.index].relativePos)
427                        diff_position = np.zeros(3)
428                        diff_rotation = np.zeros(3)
429                        for i in range(3):
430                            diff_position[i] = (
431                                self_catheter.dwells[other_dwell.index].position[i] - other_dwell.position[i])
432                            diff_rotation[i] = (
433                                self_catheter.dwells[other_dwell.index].rotation[i] - other_dwell.rotation[i])
434                        
435                        # model_construct bypasses validation checks, this is so that DwellPosition's validator
436                        # accepts the (possible) negative time field from diff_time.  
437                        dwell_diff = DwellPosition.model_construct(
438                            index=other_dwell.index,
439                            angle=diff_angle,
440                            position=diff_position,
441                            relativePos=diff_relativePos,
442                            rotation=diff_rotation,
443                            time=diff_time,
444                            # # the decision on whetheter to gen_dose_rate or not is not related to subtraction.
445                            # gen_dose_rate=diff_gen_doserate,
446                            catheter_index=other_catheter.index
447                        )
448                        list_dwell_diffs.append(dwell_diff)
449
450                    dict_catheter_diffs[other_catheter.name_id] = Catheter(
451                        index=other_catheter.index,
452                        dwells=list_dwell_diffs)
453        return CatheterTable(
454            catheters_dict=dict_catheter_diffs,
455            from_delivered_dwellpositions=self.from_delivered_dwellpositions
456        )
457
458    def set_combined_dose(self, combined_dose: BrachyDose | Path | str):
459        r"""
460        ### Purpose:
461        To set the combined dose without the dose rates.
462        ### Inputs:
463        - combined_dose : BrachyDose | Path | str: The combined dose corresponding to this catheter table.
464        If a string or Path is provided, we will load it from a file.
465        ### Outputs:
466        - None: will set self._cached_combined_dose
467        """
468        if isinstance(combined_dose, Path) or isinstance(combined_dose, str):
469            combined_dose = BrachyDose(pth_dose_file=combined_dose)

472    def append(self, catheter: Catheter) -> None:
473        r"""
474        ### Purpose:
475        - To append a catheter to the catheter table. Appending
476        will over-write the catheter.index based on the largest
477        index in self. If you would like to preserve the catheter.index
478        use __setitem__
479
480        ### Inputs:
481        - self := the CatheterTable object.
482        - catheter: Catheter := the catheter to be appended.
483
484        ### Outputs:
485        - None
486        """
487        if not isinstance(catheter, Catheter):
488            raise ValueError("catheter should be a Catheter object.")
489        new_index = len(self.catheters_dict)
490        catheter.index = new_index
491        self.catheters_list[catheter.name_id] = catheter

493    def __setitem__(self, name_id: str, new_catheter: dict | Catheter) -> None:
494        r"""
495        ### Purpose:
496        - To add a new catheter to the catheter table based on its name_id.
497        the name_id = index+1.
498        """
499        if new_catheter.name_id != name_id:
500            raise ValueError("The name_id of the new catheter does not \
501match its index, be sure that the name_id == new_catheter.index +1")
502        if not (isinstance(new_catheter, dict) or isinstance(new_catheter, Catheter)):
503            raise ValueError("The new_catheter should of type dict or Catheter")
504
505        self.catheters_dict[name_id] = (
506            new_catheter if isinstance(new_catheter, Catheter)
507            else Catheter(new_catheter))

509    def get_dwells_by_name_ids(self, name_ids: List[str]) -> List[DwellPosition]:
510        r"""
511        ### Purpose:
512        - To return dwell positions that have the queried name ids.
513        The name ids are in the format {catheter.index+1}_{dwell_index+1}_{angle}
514        ### Inputs:
515        - name_ids := The list of name ids to be returned.
516        ### Outputs:
517        - out_dwells : List[DwellPosition] := The dwell positions with the matching name ids
518        """
519        out_dwells = []
520        for name_id in name_ids:
521            for dwell in self.all_dwells:
522                if dwell.name_id == name_id:
523                    out_dwells.append(dwell)
524        return out_dwells

699    def load_dose_rates(
700        self,
701        dir_dose_rate: str| Path,
702        load_uncertainty:bool=False,
703        multi_processing: bool = True,
704        combined_dose_only: bool = False,
705        dose_dtype=np.float32,
706        ):
707        r"""
708        ### Purpose:
709        - To load the dose rates into the CatheterTable object given a folder with
710        patient's dose rate files and the catheter table loaded into the BrachyPlan object.
711        In addition, combined dose is calculated as a linear combination of the dose rates
712        and dwell times.
713        ### Inputs:
714        - `dir_dose_rate` :=  path to the directory containing the dose rate files. we assume
715        that the name of the dose rate files end as "run_X_X_X.seq.nrrd".
716        where the X corresponds to the catheter index+1, dwell index+1, and angle in increasing order.
717        - `load_uncertainty`:= If true, uncertainty is loaded from the dose file, else it'll be set to 1. 
718        - `multi_processing` := if True, the dose rate files will be loaded in parallel. By default,
719        we use 8 cores for parallel processing.
720        - `combined_dose_only`:bool = False := flag to keep only the combined dose in memory after loading.
721        ### Outputs:
722        - None := will update the BrachyPlan.dose_rate_dict attribute
723        """
724        if self.num_dwell_positions == 0:
725            raise ValueError("Cannot load dose rates since there is no catheters or dwells in this catheter table.")
726
727        dir_dose_rate = Path(dir_dose_rate).resolve()
728        if not dir_dose_rate.exists():
729            raise ValueError(f"directory of dose rates does not exist: {dir_dose_rate}")
730
731        # figure out which dwells we want to load dose rates for
732        all_dwells = self.all_dwells
733        new_dose_rate_files = [
734            dir_dose_rate/f"run_{x.name_id}.seq.nrrd" 
735            for x in all_dwells if x.gen_dose_rate]
736        # check if the paths are correct
737        for pth in new_dose_rate_files:
738            if not pth.exists():
739                raise ValueError(f"Dose rate path ({pth}) does not exist. Either run export or set gen_dose_rate \
740to False for the corresponding dwell position.")
741        from brachyutils.dose.dose_utils import BrachyDose
742        dose_rate_dict = defaultdict(BrachyDose)
743        if multi_processing:
744            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=16) as executor:
745                futures = {
746                    executor.submit(_load_single_dose_rate, pth, load_uncertainty, dose_dtype): pth
747                    for pth in new_dose_rate_files
748                    }
749                for action in tqdm(
750                    as_completed(futures),
751                    desc="Loading dose rate maps",
752                    total=len(new_dose_rate_files)):
753                    try:
754                        dose_rate = action.result()
755                        dwell_id = dose_rate.path.name.split(".")[0].split("run_")[1]
756                        dose_rate_dict[dwell_id] = dose_rate
757                    except:
758                        failed_path = futures[action]
759                        raise ValueError(f"Failed loading f{failed_path}")
760        else:
761            for pth in tqdm(
762                new_dose_rate_files,
763                desc="Loading dose rate maps",
764                total=len(new_dose_rate_files)):
765                dose_rate = _load_single_dose_rate(
766                    pth_dose_rate=pth,
767                    load_uncertainty=load_uncertainty,
768                    dtype=dose_dtype)
769                dwell_id = dose_rate.path.name.split(".")[0].split("run_")[1]
770                dose_rate_dict[dwell_id] = dose_rate
771
772        for dwell in all_dwells:
773            dwell.dose_rate = dose_rate_dict.get(dwell.name_id, None)
774            dwell.gen_dose_rate = False
775
776        # run combined dose to fill out the cached combined dose 
777        self.combined_dose
778        if load_uncertainty:
779            self._calculate_combined_uncertainty()
780        if combined_dose_only:
781            for dwell in all_dwells:
782                del dwell.dose_rate
783
784    def _calculate_combined_uncertainty(self):
785        r"""
786        ### Purpose:
787        - To calculate the combined uncertainty of the combined dose map based on the
788        dose rates and dwell times.
789        ### Inputs:
790        - self._cached_combined_dose := the BrachyDose
791        ### Outputs:
792        - None := will update the self.combined_dose.uncertainty_image
793        """
794        if self._cached_combined_dose is None:
795            raise ValueError("combined dose is not calculated yet")
796
797        treatment_time = self.catheter_table.treatment_time
798        all_dwells = self.all_dwells
799        dwells_with_doserate = [dwell for dwell in all_dwells if dwell.dose_rate is not None]
800        # sanity check the dwell times matching the treatment time
801        sanity_time = 0
802        for dwell in dwells_with_doserate:
803            sanity_time += dwell.time
804        if sanity_time != treatment_time:
805            raise ValueError(f"The treatment time is {treatment_time}, which does not \
806agree with the sum of dwells times that have dose rates ({sanity_time})")
807        for dwell in dwells_with_doserate:
808            self._cached_combined_dose.uncertainty_image.imageArray.fill(0)
809            self.combined_dose.uncertainty_image.imageArray += (
810                dwell.dose_rate.uncertainty_image.imageArray * (dwell.time/treatment_time)
811                )**2
812        self.combined_dose.uncertainty_image.imageArray = np.sqrt(
813        self.combined_dose.uncertainty_image.imageArray)
814
815    def export_dose(
816        self,
817        export_config_dose: ExportConfig_Dose
818    ):
819        r"""
820        ### Purpose:
821        - to export combined dose map and if needed the dose rate maps to a given directory.
822        exporting dose rate maps is optional.
823        ### Inputs:
824        - export_config_dose: The dose export configuration. Look at ExportConfig_Dose for more info 
825        ### Outputs:
826        - None := will export the dose map into the specified export directory.
827        ### Dependencies:
828        - _write_single_dose_rate()
829        - multiprocessing
830        """
831        dir_export = Path(export_config_dose.dir_export)
832        # write combined dose
833        self.combined_dose.write_brachydose_to_file(
834            export_config_dose.pth_combined
835        )
836        if export_config_dose.write_dose_rate_maps:
837            all_dwells = self.all_dwells
838            dose_rate_dict = {
839                dwell.name_id: dwell.dose_rate 
840                for dwell in all_dwells 
841                if dwell.dose_rate is not None}
842
843            if export_config_dose.multi_processing:
844                with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=16) as executor:
845                    futures = {
846                        executor.submit(
847                            _write_single_dose_rate,
848                            dose_rate_dict.get(dose_rate_name),
849                            dir_export,
850                            export_config_dose.file_extension,
851                            f"run_{dose_rate_name}"):
852                            dose_rate_name for dose_rate_name in dose_rate_dict
853                        }
854                    for action in tqdm(as_completed(futures), desc="Writing dose rate maps"):
855                        try:
856                            action.result()
857                        except:
858                            failed_path = futures[action]
859                            raise ValueError(f"Failed writing {failed_path}")
860            else:
861                for dwell_name in tqdm(dose_rate_dict, desc="Writing dose rate maps"):
862                    _write_single_dose_rate(
863                        dose_rate=self.dose_rate_dict.get(dwell_name),
864                        dir_export=dir_export,
865                        file_name=f"run_{dwell_name}",
866                        dose_extension=export_config_dose.file_extension)
867        print(f"Dose exported to {dir_export}")

869    def merge(self, new_catheter_table:"CatheterTable"):
870        r"""
871        ### Purpose:
872        - Given a new catheter table, merge it with self.
873        If a catheter with a specific index does not exist, it'll be added as it is.
874        If a catheter with a specific index exists but the number of dwell positions do not match, then 
875        the entire catheter will be set from the new catheter table. If a catheter with a specific index
876        exists and the number of dwell positions match then the self catheter will be updated.
877        ### Inputs:
878        - new_catheter_table:CatheterTable := The new catheter table used
879        to update self.
880        ### Output:
881        None := update self.
882        """
883        catheter_table_diff = self - new_catheter_table
884        self._time_diffs = {}
885
886        for catheter_diff in catheter_table_diff:
887            new_catheter = new_catheter_table[catheter_diff.name_id]
888            self_catheter = self[catheter_diff.name_id]
889            if self_catheter is None:
890                # new catheter does not exist, add it to the catheter table
891                # its name_id should be that of new catheter table
892                self[catheter_diff.name_id] = new_catheter
893                continue
894            else:
895                if self_catheter.num_dwell_positions != catheter_diff.num_dwell_positions:
896                    # if the number of dwell positions does not match self, rewrite the catheter
897                    self[catheter_diff.name_id] = new_catheter
898                    continue
899                else:
900                    for dwell_diff in catheter_diff.dwells:
901                        self_dwell = self_catheter.dwells[dwell_diff.index]
902                        new_dwell = new_catheter.dwells[dwell_diff.index]
903                        if (np.any(dwell_diff.position !=0) or np.any(dwell_diff.rotation !=0)
904                            or dwell_diff.angle != 0):
905                            new_gen_doserate = True
906                        else:
907                            new_gen_doserate = self_dwell.gen_dose_rate 
908                            self._time_diffs[dwell_diff.name_id] = dwell_diff.time
909                        dwell_attrs_conds = [
910                            ("angle", dwell_diff.angle!=0),
911                            ("position", np.any(dwell_diff.position!=0)),
912                            ("rotation", np.any(dwell_diff.rotation!=0)),
913                            ("relativePos", dwell_diff.relativePos!=0),
914                            ("time", dwell_diff.time!=0),
915                        ]
916                        for attr, cond in dwell_attrs_conds:
917                            if cond:
918                                self_dwell.__setattr__(
919                                    attr,
920                                    new_dwell.__getattribute__(attr))
921                        self_dwell.gen_dose_rate = new_gen_doserate
922
923    def reset_dwelltimes_to(self, reset_value:float = 1.0):
924        r"""
925        ### Purpose:
926        - To reset the dwell times of all the dwell positions in the catheter table to a specific value.
927        This is useful when we want to generate dose rates for all the dwell positions without changing
928        the position, rotation or angle of the dwell positions.
929        ### Inputs:
930        - reset_value:float = 1.0 := The value to which the dwell times will be reset. By default, it is 1.0 second.
931        ### Outputs:
932        - None := will update the dwell times of all the dwell positions in the catheter table.
933        """
934        for dwell in self.all_dwells:
935            dwell.time = reset_value
936            dwell.gen_dose_rate = True

    1. from a dicom file 1.1. from the delivered dwell positions 1.2. from the digitization points
    2. from a list of catheter dictionaries
    3. from a json file

131        self,

133        r"""

136        
137        ### Inputs:

141        - Dict[str, List[List[float]]] := the dictionary mapping each catheter to the list of

150            non_zero_dwell_positions[f"Needle_{catheter.index}"] = dwell_positions
151        return non_zero_dwell_positions

153    @computed_field
154    def combined_dose(self) -> 'BrachyDose':
155        """
156        ### Purpose:
157        - To calculate the combined dose by multiplying the dose rates with the dwell times.
158        if this value has already been cached without change to the catheter table, then
159        the cache will be returned.
160        We require strict name matching between the _time_diffs and dwell.name_id
161        ### Inputs:
162        - self._cached_combined_dose: The combined dose caclualted previously, which will 
163        be returned if no change to the catheter table has been made.
164        - self._time_diffs: a dictionary of time differences for each dwell in the plan. 
165        This is used to update the combined dose if the dwell times are updated without
166        having to reload the dose rate maps. The keys of the dictionary should be in
167        the format "{catheter.index+1}{dwell.index+1}{dwell.angle" and the values
168        should be the time differences in seconds. If None, the combined dose will
169        be calculated using the current dwell times in the plan.
170        ### Outputs:
171        - self._cached_combined_dose
172        also resets self._time_diffs to None for future.
173        """
174        from brachyutils.dose.dose_utils import BrachyDose
175        all_dwells: List[DwellPosition] = self.all_dwells
176        dwells_with_doserate = [dwell for dwell in all_dwells if dwell.dose_rate is not None]
177        
178        if not dwells_with_doserate:
179            return self._cached_combined_dose
180            # raise ValueError("No dose rate found in this catheter table")
181
182        # Initialize combined dose if not cached
183        if self._cached_combined_dose is None:
184            self._cached_combined_dose = BrachyDose.dose_with_empty_grid_like(
185            dwells_with_doserate[0].dose_rate
186            )
187
188        # Calculate combined dose with or without time diffs
189        for dwell in dwells_with_doserate:
190            dwell_time = (
191            self._time_diffs.get(dwell.name_id, 0) 
192            if self._time_diffs is not None 
193            else dwell.time
194            )
195            if dwell_time != 0:
196                self._cached_combined_dose.dose_image.imageArray += (
197                    dwell.dose_rate.dose_image.imageArray * dwell_time)
198        # reset the time diffs for future
199        self._time_diffs = None
200        return self._cached_combined_dose

Purpose:

  • To calculate the combined dose by multiplying the dose rates with the dwell times. if this value has already been cached without change to the catheter table, then the cache will be returned. We require strict name matching between the _time_diffs and dwell.name_id

    Inputs:

  • self._cached_combined_dose: The combined dose caclualted previously, which will be returned if no change to the catheter table has been made.

  • self._time_diffs: a dictionary of time differences for each dwell in the plan. This is used to update the combined dose if the dwell times are updated without having to reload the dose rate maps. The keys of the dictionary should be in the format "{catheter.index+1}{dwell.index+1}{dwell.angle" and the values should be the time differences in seconds. If None, the combined dose will be calculated using the current dwell times in the plan.

    Outputs:

  • self._cached_combined_dose also resets self._time_diffs to None for future.

202    @model_validator(mode="after")
203    def validate_catheter_table(self):
204        r"""
205        ### Purpose:
206        - To initialize the CatheterTable object.
207        
208        ### Inputs:
209        - catheters_dict: List[Catheter] | List[dict] | str | Path | CatheterSetUp | CreatedSetUp :=
210        the list of catheter objects in the catheter table or the path to a json or dicom file.
211        - step_size: float := the step size in mm between the dwell positions on the catheter table.
212        - from_delivered_dwellpositions: bool := if true, the dwell positions inside the delivered dwell positions will be used.
213        ### Outputs:
214        - CatheterTable := the catheter table object.
215        """
216        if (isinstance(self.catheters_dict, str) or
217            isinstance(self.catheters_dict, Path)
218            ):
219            catheter_file = Path(self.catheters_dict)
220
221            if not catheter_file.exists():
222                raise ValueError(f"catheter file {catheter_file} does not exist.")
223            if str(catheter_file).endswith(".mrk.json"):
224                # if the file is a slicer markup file, load it as a json file
225                raise NotImplementedError("this feature is not implemented yet.")
226
227            if str(catheter_file).endswith(".json"):
228                cat_dict = load_from_json(catheter_file)
229            elif str(catheter_file).endswith(".dcm"):
230                cat_dict = load_from_dicom(
231                    pth_dicom=catheter_file,
232                    from_delivered_dwellpositions=self.from_delivered_dwellpositions,
233                )
234            self.catheters_dict = cat_dict["catheter_list"]
235            self.step_size = cat_dict["step_size"]
236
237        elif isinstance(self.catheters_dict, CatheterSetUp):
238            # if the catheters_dict is a CatheterSetUp object, convert it to a CatheterTable
239            cat_setup = self.catheters_dict
240            updated_catheter_dict = _update_catheter_table(
241                catheter_table = cat_setup.catheter_table,
242                digitization_points=cat_setup.digitization_points,
243                fit_function=cat_setup.piece_wise_lines,
244                tips=cat_setup.get_tips_coords(),
245                step_size=cat_setup.step_size,
246            )
247            self.catheters_dict = updated_catheter_dict["catheter_list"]
248            self.step_size = updated_catheter_dict["step_size"]
249
250        elif isinstance(self.catheters_dict, CreatedSetUp):
251            created_setup = self.catheters_dict
252            updated_catheter_dict = created_setup.to_brachyutils_CatheterTable_format()
253            self.catheters_dict = updated_catheter_dict["catheter_list"]
254            self.step_size = updated_catheter_dict["step_size"]
255            self.non_zero_dwell_positions = created_setup.get_non_zero_dwell_positions()
256
257        if isinstance(self.catheters_dict, list):
258            # if catheter dict is a list, convert it to a dict
259            real_dict = defaultdict(Catheter)
260            for cat in self.catheters_dict:
261                cat_obj = Catheter(**cat) if isinstance(cat, dict) else cat
262                real_dict[cat_obj.name_id] = cat_obj
263            self.catheters_dict = real_dict
264
265        # check if the values are dicts or catheter\
266        # self.catheters_dict = {
267        #     key: Catheter(val) if isinstance(val, dict) else val
268        #     for key, val in self.catheters_dict.items()
269        # }
270
271        return self

Purpose:

  • To initialize the CatheterTable object.

Inputs:

  • catheters_dict: List[Catheter] | List[dict] | str | Path | CatheterSetUp | CreatedSetUp := the list of catheter objects in the catheter table or the path to a json or dicom file.
  • step_size: float := the step size in mm between the dwell positions on the catheter table.

  • from_delivered_dwellpositions: bool := if true, the dwell positions inside the delivered dwell positions will be used.

    Outputs:

  • CatheterTable := the catheter table object.

472    def append(self, catheter: Catheter) -> None:
473        r"""
474        ### Purpose:
475        - To append a catheter to the catheter table. Appending
476        will over-write the catheter.index based on the largest
477        index in self. If you would like to preserve the catheter.index
478        use __setitem__
479
480        ### Inputs:
481        - self := the CatheterTable object.
482        - catheter: Catheter := the catheter to be appended.
483
484        ### Outputs:
485        - None
486        """
487        if not isinstance(catheter, Catheter):
488            raise ValueError("catheter should be a Catheter object.")
489        new_index = len(self.catheters_dict)
490        catheter.index = new_index
491        self.catheters_list[catheter.name_id] = catheter

def load_dose_rates( self, dir_dose_rate: str | pathlib._local.Path, load_uncertainty: bool = False, multi_processing: bool = True, combined_dose_only: bool = False, dose_dtype=<class 'numpy.float32'>): 
699    def load_dose_rates(
700        self,
701        dir_dose_rate: str| Path,
702        load_uncertainty:bool=False,
703        multi_processing: bool = True,
704        combined_dose_only: bool = False,
705        dose_dtype=np.float32,
706        ):
707        r"""
708        ### Purpose:
709        - To load the dose rates into the CatheterTable object given a folder with
710        patient's dose rate files and the catheter table loaded into the BrachyPlan object.
711        In addition, combined dose is calculated as a linear combination of the dose rates
712        and dwell times.
713        ### Inputs:
714        - `dir_dose_rate` :=  path to the directory containing the dose rate files. we assume
715        that the name of the dose rate files end as "run_X_X_X.seq.nrrd".
716        where the X corresponds to the catheter index+1, dwell index+1, and angle in increasing order.
717        - `load_uncertainty`:= If true, uncertainty is loaded from the dose file, else it'll be set to 1. 
718        - `multi_processing` := if True, the dose rate files will be loaded in parallel. By default,
719        we use 8 cores for parallel processing.
720        - `combined_dose_only`:bool = False := flag to keep only the combined dose in memory after loading.
721        ### Outputs:
722        - None := will update the BrachyPlan.dose_rate_dict attribute
723        """
724        if self.num_dwell_positions == 0:
725            raise ValueError("Cannot load dose rates since there is no catheters or dwells in this catheter table.")
726
727        dir_dose_rate = Path(dir_dose_rate).resolve()
728        if not dir_dose_rate.exists():
729            raise ValueError(f"directory of dose rates does not exist: {dir_dose_rate}")
730
731        # figure out which dwells we want to load dose rates for
732        all_dwells = self.all_dwells
733        new_dose_rate_files = [
734            dir_dose_rate/f"run_{x.name_id}.seq.nrrd" 
735            for x in all_dwells if x.gen_dose_rate]
736        # check if the paths are correct
737        for pth in new_dose_rate_files:
738            if not pth.exists():
739                raise ValueError(f"Dose rate path ({pth}) does not exist. Either run export or set gen_dose_rate \
740to False for the corresponding dwell position.")
741        from brachyutils.dose.dose_utils import BrachyDose
742        dose_rate_dict = defaultdict(BrachyDose)
743        if multi_processing:
744            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=16) as executor:
745                futures = {
746                    executor.submit(_load_single_dose_rate, pth, load_uncertainty, dose_dtype): pth
747                    for pth in new_dose_rate_files
748                    }
749                for action in tqdm(
750                    as_completed(futures),
751                    desc="Loading dose rate maps",
752                    total=len(new_dose_rate_files)):
753                    try:
754                        dose_rate = action.result()
755                        dwell_id = dose_rate.path.name.split(".")[0].split("run_")[1]
756                        dose_rate_dict[dwell_id] = dose_rate
757                    except:
758                        failed_path = futures[action]
759                        raise ValueError(f"Failed loading f{failed_path}")
760        else:
761            for pth in tqdm(
762                new_dose_rate_files,
763                desc="Loading dose rate maps",
764                total=len(new_dose_rate_files)):
765                dose_rate = _load_single_dose_rate(
766                    pth_dose_rate=pth,
767                    load_uncertainty=load_uncertainty,
768                    dtype=dose_dtype)
769                dwell_id = dose_rate.path.name.split(".")[0].split("run_")[1]
770                dose_rate_dict[dwell_id] = dose_rate
771
772        for dwell in all_dwells:
773            dwell.dose_rate = dose_rate_dict.get(dwell.name_id, None)
774            dwell.gen_dose_rate = False
775
776        # run combined dose to fill out the cached combined dose 
777        self.combined_dose
778        if load_uncertainty:
779            self._calculate_combined_uncertainty()
780        if combined_dose_only:
781            for dwell in all_dwells:
782                del dwell.dose_rate

Purpose:

  • To load the dose rates into the CatheterTable object given a folder with patient's dose rate files and the catheter table loaded into the BrachyPlan object. In addition, combined dose is calculated as a linear combination of the dose rates and dwell times.

    Inputs:

  • dir_dose_rate := path to the directory containing the dose rate files. we assume that the name of the dose rate files end as "run_X_X_X.seq.nrrd". where the X corresponds to the catheter index+1, dwell index+1, and angle in increasing order.

  • load_uncertainty:= If true, uncertainty is loaded from the dose file, else it'll be set to 1.
  • multi_processing := if True, the dose rate files will be loaded in parallel. By default, we use 8 cores for parallel processing.

  • combined_dose_only:bool = False := flag to keep only the combined dose in memory after loading.

    Outputs:

  • None := will update the BrachyPlan.dose_rate_dict attribute

def export_dose(self, export_config_dose: brachyutils.brachy_types.ExportConfig_Dose): 
815    def export_dose(
816        self,
817        export_config_dose: ExportConfig_Dose
818    ):
819        r"""
820        ### Purpose:
821        - to export combined dose map and if needed the dose rate maps to a given directory.
822        exporting dose rate maps is optional.
823        ### Inputs:
824        - export_config_dose: The dose export configuration. Look at ExportConfig_Dose for more info 
825        ### Outputs:
826        - None := will export the dose map into the specified export directory.
827        ### Dependencies:
828        - _write_single_dose_rate()
829        - multiprocessing
830        """
831        dir_export = Path(export_config_dose.dir_export)
832        # write combined dose
833        self.combined_dose.write_brachydose_to_file(
834            export_config_dose.pth_combined
835        )
836        if export_config_dose.write_dose_rate_maps:
837            all_dwells = self.all_dwells
838            dose_rate_dict = {
839                dwell.name_id: dwell.dose_rate 
840                for dwell in all_dwells 
841                if dwell.dose_rate is not None}
842
843            if export_config_dose.multi_processing:
844                with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=16) as executor:
845                    futures = {
846                        executor.submit(
847                            _write_single_dose_rate,
848                            dose_rate_dict.get(dose_rate_name),
849                            dir_export,
850                            export_config_dose.file_extension,
851                            f"run_{dose_rate_name}"):
852                            dose_rate_name for dose_rate_name in dose_rate_dict
853                        }
854                    for action in tqdm(as_completed(futures), desc="Writing dose rate maps"):
855                        try:
856                            action.result()
857                        except:
858                            failed_path = futures[action]
859                            raise ValueError(f"Failed writing {failed_path}")
860            else:
861                for dwell_name in tqdm(dose_rate_dict, desc="Writing dose rate maps"):
862                    _write_single_dose_rate(
863                        dose_rate=self.dose_rate_dict.get(dwell_name),
864                        dir_export=dir_export,
865                        file_name=f"run_{dwell_name}",
866                        dose_extension=export_config_dose.file_extension)
867        print(f"Dose exported to {dir_export}")

def merge( self, new_catheter_table: CatheterTable): 
869    def merge(self, new_catheter_table:"CatheterTable"):
870        r"""
871        ### Purpose:
872        - Given a new catheter table, merge it with self.
873        If a catheter with a specific index does not exist, it'll be added as it is.
874        If a catheter with a specific index exists but the number of dwell positions do not match, then 
875        the entire catheter will be set from the new catheter table. If a catheter with a specific index
876        exists and the number of dwell positions match then the self catheter will be updated.
877        ### Inputs:
878        - new_catheter_table:CatheterTable := The new catheter table used
879        to update self.
880        ### Output:
881        None := update self.
882        """
883        catheter_table_diff = self - new_catheter_table
884        self._time_diffs = {}
885
886        for catheter_diff in catheter_table_diff:
887            new_catheter = new_catheter_table[catheter_diff.name_id]
888            self_catheter = self[catheter_diff.name_id]
889            if self_catheter is None:
890                # new catheter does not exist, add it to the catheter table
891                # its name_id should be that of new catheter table
892                self[catheter_diff.name_id] = new_catheter
893                continue
894            else:
895                if self_catheter.num_dwell_positions != catheter_diff.num_dwell_positions:
896                    # if the number of dwell positions does not match self, rewrite the catheter
897                    self[catheter_diff.name_id] = new_catheter
898                    continue
899                else:
900                    for dwell_diff in catheter_diff.dwells:
901                        self_dwell = self_catheter.dwells[dwell_diff.index]
902                        new_dwell = new_catheter.dwells[dwell_diff.index]
903                        if (np.any(dwell_diff.position !=0) or np.any(dwell_diff.rotation !=0)
904                            or dwell_diff.angle != 0):
905                            new_gen_doserate = True
906                        else:
907                            new_gen_doserate = self_dwell.gen_dose_rate 
908                            self._time_diffs[dwell_diff.name_id] = dwell_diff.time
909                        dwell_attrs_conds = [
910                            ("angle", dwell_diff.angle!=0),
911                            ("position", np.any(dwell_diff.position!=0)),
912                            ("rotation", np.any(dwell_diff.rotation!=0)),
913                            ("relativePos", dwell_diff.relativePos!=0),
914                            ("time", dwell_diff.time!=0),
915                        ]
916                        for attr, cond in dwell_attrs_conds:
917                            if cond:
918                                self_dwell.__setattr__(
919                                    attr,
920                                    new_dwell.__getattribute__(attr))
921                        self_dwell.gen_dose_rate = new_gen_doserate

Purpose:

  • Given a new catheter table, merge it with self. If a catheter with a specific index does not exist, it'll be added as it is. If a catheter with a specific index exists but the number of dwell positions do not match, then the entire catheter will be set from the new catheter table. If a catheter with a specific index exists and the number of dwell positions match then the self catheter will be updated.

    Inputs:

  • new_catheter_table:CatheterTable := The new catheter table used to update self.

    Output:

None := update self.

def get_uniform_phantom( voxel_value: float = 0.0, gridSize: List[int] = [100, 100, 100], spacing: List[float] = [1.0, 1.0, 1.0], origin: List[float] = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]) -> BrachyPhantom: 
1273def get_uniform_phantom(
1274    voxel_value: float = 0.0,
1275    gridSize: List[int] = [100, 100, 100],
1276    spacing: List[float] = [1.0, 1.0, 1.0],
1277    origin: List[float] = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
1278    )-> BrachyPhantom:
1279    r"""
1280    ### Purpose:
1281    - Create a uniform cubic phantom object where all the voxels have the same value.
1282
1283    ### Inputs:
1284    - voxel_value: float := the value of the voxels in the phantom.
1285    - gridSizeInMilimeters: List[int] := the size of the phantom in millimeters.
1286    - spacing: List[float] := the spacing of the phantom in millimeters.
1287    - origin: List[float] := the origin of the phantom in millimeters.
1288
1289    ### Outputs:
1290    - phantom: BrachyPhantom := the new phantom object.
1291    """
1292    phantom = BrachyPhantom()
1293    phantom.image_obj = Image3D(
1294        imageArray=np.ones(gridSize) * voxel_value,
1295        spacing=spacing,
1296        origin=origin,
1297    )
1298    phantom.image_modality = None
1299    phantom.structure_set = None
1300    phantom.structure_names = []
1301    phantom.unit_length = "cm"
1302    phantom.xyz_format = "LPS"
1303
1304    return phantom

Purpose:

  • gridSizeInMilimeters: List[int] := the size of the phantom in millimeters.
  • spacing: List[float] := the spacing of the phantom in millimeters.
  • origin: List[float] := the origin of the phantom in millimeters.

Outputs:

  • phantom: BrachyPhantom := the new phantom object.

def mask_to_stl( roi_mask: opentps.core.data.images._roiMask.ROIMask, pth_output: pathlib._local.Path) -> None: 
1854def mask_to_stl(roi_mask: ROIMask, pth_output: Path) -> None:
1855    r"""
1856    Purpose:
1857        - Convert an ROI mask to an STL file.
1858    
1859    Inputs:
1860        - roi_mask: ROIMask := The ROI mask object containing the 3D binary mask data to be converted.
1861        - pth_output: Path := The output file path where the STL file will be saved.
1862    
1863    Outputs:
1864        - None
1865    """
1866    import vtk
1867    # Note: Implementation is cannablized from PolySeg (https://github.com/PerkLab/PolySeg/)
1868    if not isinstance(roi_mask, ROIMask):
1869        raise ValueError("The input roi_mask should be an instance of ROIMask.")
1870
1871    elif not pth_output.suffix.lower() == ".stl":
1872        raise ValueError("The output file must have a .stl extension.")
1873    
1874    # Get mask data in [z, y, x] format for VTK
1875    mask_array = roi_mask.imageArray.astype(np.uint8)
1876    
1877    # Create VTK image data
1878    vtk_image = vtk.vtkImageData()
1879    vtk_image.SetDimensions(mask_array.shape)
1880    vtk_image.SetSpacing(roi_mask.spacing)
1881    vtk_image.SetOrigin(roi_mask.origin)
1882    vtk_image.GetPointData().SetScalars(vtk.util.numpy_support.numpy_to_vtk(
1883        num_array=mask_array.ravel(order='F'),
1884        deep=True,
1885        array_type=vtk.VTK_UNSIGNED_CHAR,
1886    ))
1887
1888    
1889    # Pad the image if border voxels are non-zero to ensure closed surface
1890    extent = vtk_image.GetExtent()
1891    padder = vtk.vtkImageConstantPad()
1892    padder.SetInputData(vtk_image)
1893    padder.SetOutputWholeExtent(
1894        extent[0] - 1, extent[1] + 1,
1895        extent[2] - 1, extent[3] + 1,
1896        extent[4] - 1, extent[5] + 1
1897    )
1898    padder.SetConstant(0)
1899    padder.Update()
1900    vtk_image = padder.GetOutput()
1901    
1902    # Use Flying Edges (faster than marching cubes) or Marching Cubes for surface extraction
1903    marching_cubes = vtk.vtkDiscreteFlyingEdges3D()
1904
1905    marching_cubes.SetInputData(vtk_image)
1906    marching_cubes.SetValue(0, 1)  # Extract surface at label value 1
1907    marching_cubes.ComputeGradientsOff()
1908    marching_cubes.ComputeNormalsOff()
1909    marching_cubes.Update()
1910    
1911    poly_data = marching_cubes.GetOutput()
1912    
1913    if poly_data.GetNumberOfPolys() == 0:
1914        raise ValueError("No surface could be generated from the mask. The mask may be empty.")
1915    
1916
1917    print(f"Pre-filtration mesh quality: {poly_data.GetNumberOfPolys()} polygons")
1918    i = 0
1919    while poly_data.GetNumberOfPolys() > 10000 and i < 10:
1920        print(f"Current mesh quality: {poly_data.GetNumberOfPolys()} polygons")
1921        # Apply decimation (0.0 = no decimation, using minimal decimation)
1922        decimation_factor = 0.5
1923        if decimation_factor > 0.0:
1924            decimator = vtk.vtkDecimatePro()
1925            decimator.SetInputData(poly_data)
1926            decimator.SetTargetReduction(decimation_factor)
1927            decimator.SetFeatureAngle(60)
1928            decimator.SplittingOff()
1929            decimator.PreserveTopologyOn()
1930            decimator.SetMaximumError(1.0)
1931            decimator.Update()
1932            poly_data = decimator.GetOutput()
1933                
1934        # Apply smoothing (0.5 = moderate smoothing)
1935        smoothing_factor = 1.0
1936        if smoothing_factor > 0:
1937            smoother = vtk.vtkWindowedSincPolyDataFilter()
1938            smoother.SetInputData(poly_data)
1939            smoother.SetNumberOfIterations(50)
1940            # Map smoothing factor to pass band: 0.0->1.0, 0.5->0.01, 1.0->0.001
1941            pass_band = pow(10.0, -4.0 * smoothing_factor)
1942            smoother.SetPassBand(pass_band)
1943            smoother.BoundarySmoothingOn()
1944            smoother.FeatureEdgeSmoothingOn()
1945            smoother.NonManifoldSmoothingOn()
1946            smoother.NormalizeCoordinatesOn()
1947            smoother.Update()
1948            poly_data = smoother.GetOutput()
1949        print(f"Iter {i+1} post-smoothing mesh quality: {poly_data.GetNumberOfPolys()} polygons")
1950        i += 1
1951
1952    #clean the mesh
1953    cleaner = vtk.vtkCleanPolyData()
1954    cleaner.SetInputData(poly_data)
1955    cleaner.SetTolerance(1e-3)
1956    cleaner.SetPointMerging(True)
1957    cleaner.SetConvertLinesToPoints(True)
1958    cleaner.SetConvertPolysToLines(True)
1959    cleaner.SetConvertStripsToPolys(True)
1960    cleaner.Update()
1961    poly_data = cleaner.GetOutput()
1962        
1963    print(f"Final mesh quality: {poly_data.GetNumberOfPolys()} polygons")
1964        
1965    # Write to STL file
1966    writer = vtk.vtkSTLWriter()
1967    writer.SetFileName(str(pth_output))
1968    writer.SetInputData(poly_data)
1969    writer.Write()
1970
1971    print(f"STL file saved to {pth_output}")

Purpose: - Convert an ROI mask to an STL file.

Inputs: - roi_mask: ROIMask := The ROI mask object containing the 3D binary mask data to be converted. - pth_output: Path := The output file path where the STL file will be saved.

Outputs: - None
